jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
The **IT Project Manager** ensures successful and timely execution of technical programs across multiple teams in multiple locations and throughout the full system development life cycle working closely with IT and business partners. Role will align to Information Technology PMO. The successful candidate will work closely with IT Leadership to deliver projects within the IT Portfolio.

**\*\*This REMOTE opportunity is not eligible for employer-visa sponsorship \*\***

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Project Tracking & Reporting – Monitor project status, track technical issues, and provide clear and effective reporting on milestones, deliverables, expectations, dependencies, risks, mitigation plans, escalations, and overall progress.
* Coaching and support project team to follow PMO processes and procedures to support on time, quality, and scope goals.
* Stakeholder Communication & Issue Management – Facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders, addressing project-related concerns and ensuring alignment on integration and deployment efforts.
* Program Governance & Best Practices – Drive program integrity and coherence by maintaining an effective environment within PMO, establishing program-related practices, templates, policies, tools, and partnerships to improve organizational capabilities.
* End-to-End Project Lifecycle Management – Take full ownership of the project lifecycle, from demo and field trials to integration planning and deployment, ensuring smooth execution across all phases.
* Independent Project Execution & Collaboration – Work autonomously to manage daily project activities, maintain collaboration forums, and track overall program success criteria through performance metrics and reports.
* Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement – Develop and maintain standardized processes for project execution, leveraging best practices from PMO to enhance efficiency and scalability.
* Project Documentation & Compliance – Create and maintain project documentation, ensuring adherence to both standard and internal processes

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) in business administration, computer science, engineering, medical technology, or related field of study
* 6+ years’ experience in IT project management, program management or portfolio management roles

**Preferred Experience**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification.
* Commercial, medical device or manufacturing program management experience
* 2-4 years’ experience in Agile project methodologies.
* Effective written and oral communications in English
* Proficient in Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* An ability to build models and analyze costs, risks, timelines, metrics, etc. using Excel.

**This position is not eligible for employer-visa sponsorship**

Disclosure as required by applicable law, the annual salary range for this position is $104,134 - $163,640. The actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, work experience, education and skill level. The salary range is CONMED’s good faith belief at the time of this posting.

This job posting is anticipated to close on August 29, 2026. We may, however, extend this time period, in which case the posting will remain available on careers.conmed.com. Please submit your application as soon as possible as we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis as we receive them.

**Benefits:**

CONMED offers a wide array of benefits to fit your unique needs. Visit our Benefits Page for more information.

* Competitive compensation
* Excellent healthcare including medical, dental, vision and prescription coverage
Short & long term disability plus life insurance* - cost paid fully by CONMED
Retirement Savings Plan (401K)* - CONMED matches your contributions dollar for dollar, with the potential for up to 7% per pay period
Employee Stock Purchase Plan* - allows stock purchases at discounted price
* Tuition assistance for undergraduate and graduate level courses

**Know someone at CONMED?** Have them submit you as a referral before applying for this position to be eligible for our Employee Referral Program incentives!

CONMED is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic. Protected veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal Poster reaffirms this commitment.

Colorado Residents: In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

If you feel you need a reasonable accommodation pursuant to the ADA, you are encouraged to contact us at 800-929-7176 option #5.

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager - Boston
jobs.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

**Strategic Program Manager (SPM) – Join Our World-Class Team at MISUMI Americas!**

As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at MISUMI Americas, you'll partner with leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches without sacrificing quality. Acting as a trusted advisor, you'll bring deep expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every stage — from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production.

You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment teams to scope, plan, and execute complex programs, ensuring products launch on time, within budget, and at the highest quality standards. Your ability to align internal teams with customer goals will be central to delivering consistent, measurable value across the full product lifecycle.

Beyond program execution, you'll play an active role in continuous improvement — identifying opportunities to refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that make MISUMI Americas an even stronger partner for its customers.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships to deliver high-quality customer experiences that drive long-term loyalty.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with pre- & post-sale teams to ensure on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Leverage your technical expertise in engineering and manufacturing alongside strong program management skills to identify risks early, develop risk mitigation plans, and manage changes to keep projects on track.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the program, providing valuable insights and guidance to both internal teams and customers to ensure alignment and clarity.
* Monitor and report program milestones making necessary adjustments to timelines and deliverables, to meet customer expectations and maintain high-quality standards.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Facilitate regular status meetings with customers and internal teams to clearly communicate requirements, timelines, and quality standards, ensuring alignment and proactively resolving any blockers.
* All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

**Desired Traits:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering.
* 5+ years of experience managing projects/ programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and high-volume manufacturing facilities.
* Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC Machining, 3D Printing, Injection Molding, Sheet Metal Fabrication, Die Casting, or Assembly.
* Customer-Facing Experience to lead complex, consultative technical sales engagements, leveraging operational expertise to drive success.
* Strong program management, risk management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines within a structured framework.
* Proficiency in standard program management tools and software used for tracking, communication, and reporting across distributed teams.
* Self-starter, with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving problems and building deep, meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrates a focus on process optimization, service enhancement, and driving customer success.
* Passionate about learning, building solutions, and tackling challenges.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with experience working across multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.

At MISUMI Americas you will be part of an innovative team that is redefining the future of manufacturing. If you're excited by challenges, passionate about delivering customer success, and eager to continuously learn and grow, we want to hear from you!

### **Perks and Benefits**

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K plan
* Monthly Virtual Work stipend for things like food, internet, travel, pet care, health and wellness
* Parental leave programs
* Paid volunteer days
* Onboarding setup, including: standing desk, laptop, monitor, and chair, and a stipend for additional items such as headphones, blue light glasses, or any other ergonomic supplies you may want or need
* And much, much more!

Salary Range: $123,000 to $145,000 USD per year, depending upon experience

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**

We're actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobs.location: Randolph A F B, TX, USA
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Salesforce Project Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Summary:** The Salesforce Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Salesforce sustainment, enhancement, and modernization initiatives. This role will manage cross-functional teams, oversee requirements and release activities, address risks and dependencies, and coordinate phased transitions while maintaining operational continuity. The Project Manager will work closely with customer stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners to improve system capabilities, data insights, user experience, and long-term platform performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead Salesforce initiatives through planning, requirements, development, testing, deployment, and sustainment.
* Support government leadership in managing project scope, schedule, cost, resources, risks, and delivery performance.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to document, validate, and prioritize requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate cross-functional and multi-vendor teams supporting development, integration, data, security, testing, training, and production operations.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies, manage the product backlog, and monitor sprint capacity, milestones, and release readiness.
* Identify and resolve risks, issues, and dependencies involving Salesforce configuration, integrations, environments, data, and deployments.
* Provide clear project status, performance metrics, risks, decisions, and required actions to government and program stakeholders.
* Support change control, phased transitions, user adoption, documentation, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Track Salesforce licenses, utilization, renewals, and projected requirements in coordination with government and vendor stakeholders.
* Ensure delivery activities align with applicable federal and DoD security, compliance, accessibility, and reporting requirements.

**Required Certifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator
* Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant or Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant

**Preferred Qualifications and Certifications**

* Experience supporting Salesforce Government Cloud or another regulated government cloud environment.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, release governance, automated testing, data migration, system integration, and production-support processes.
* Experience supporting help-desk operations, incident management, problem management, service-level reporting, and continual service improvement.
* Experience with RMF, ATO, FedRAMP, DoD cybersecurity, Section 508, and government records-management requirements.
* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant or Sales Cloud Consultant, whichever is not held as the required Cloud certification
* Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
* PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, SAFe Agilist, or Certified ScrumMaster.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Program Analyst
jobs.description:
A3 Technology, Inc. is seeking a Program Analyst to support the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Technical Operations (AJW) organizations as a member of the AJW-173 In-Service Management Team. This position requires the successful candidate to support lifecycle and in-service management activities across National Airspace System (NAS) programs, including program coordination, communications, financial tracking, and stakeholder engagement.

  

The candidate will assist in development of program products, status reporting, lifecycle documentation, and briefings supporting NAS systems and AJW portfolio management activities.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop, format, and maintain reports, briefings, correspondence, and presentations for program and organizational communication.
* Coordinate and manage meetings, including scheduling, agenda development, facilitation support, and preparation/distribution of meeting minutes.
* Perform data entry, tracking, and reporting using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Project, Teams) and Google Workspace tools.
* Maintain program files, records, and documentation repositories (including SharePoint and other collaboration platforms).
* Track administrative and programmatic actions, including correspondence and contract-related activities.
* Support travel coordination, training events, and program logistics.
* Support lifecycle management activities aligned with FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) phases, including pre- and post-In-Service Decision activities.
* Track, review, and manage program artifacts and documentation through completion and acceptance.
* Maintain awareness of program status within the NAS lifecycle and support execution of In-Service Management SOP activities.
* Assist in planning and analysis of NAS capabilities to support current and future mission needs.
* Coordinate with stakeholders including AJW In-Service Managers and Program Management Organizations (e.g., AJM).
* Support development and tracking of program schedules, milestones, and status reporting.
* Assist with risk and issue management activities, including tracking, analysis, and mitigation support.
* Conduct research, data analysis, and provide recommendations to support program decisions.
* Develop dashboards, charts, and visualizations to communicate program performance and status.
* Support lessons learned activities, stakeholder feedback sessions, and program improvement initiatives.
* Assist in financial planning activities, including budget tracking, expenditure analysis, and reconciliation reporting.
* Support development of financial reports and provide data-driven insights to management.
* Assist with lifecycle management and accountability of Government Furnished Equipment (GFE), including inventory tracking and property records.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams, program management, and stakeholders.
* Develop program communications including newsletters, updates, and stakeholder briefings.
* Support cross-organizational coordination and collaboration efforts.
* Assist in development and implementation of processes to improve program tracking and execution.
* Support SharePoint site development and maintenance (architecture, permissions, workflows, content management).
* Support tracking and processing of National Change Proposals (NCPs), including coordination and documentation.

  

**Skills Required:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree required (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in program analysis, project support, or administrative/program management roles.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to support technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Project).
* Experience with data tracking, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* US Citizenship required; must be able to obtain/maintain government clearance.

  

**Skills Preferred:**

* Prior FAA experience, particularly within Technical Operations (AJW) or NAS lifecycle support.
* Familiarity with FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) and In-Service Management processes.
* Experience supporting program schedules, risk management, and lifecycle documentation.
* Experience with SharePoint development and administration.
* Experience with financial tracking and budget analysis.
* Experience supporting logistics, asset management, or property tracking processes.
* Familiarity with National Airspace System (NAS) programs and infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace.

  

Additionally, US Citizenship or documented proof of eligibility to work in the US is a must. Upon receiving a conditional offer of employment, candidates will undergo a Government investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for Government clearance. Verification of past employment, education and references is also required. It is imperative that candidates be either a US citizen or a current green card holder with the last 3 consecutive years as a resident of the US.

In addition, compensation may be influenced by applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and established contract wage rates.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking an experienced and decisive **Program Manager (PM)** to lead the execution of a missile development and production program. In this leadership role, you will hold operational accountability for project success, ensuring that complex, multi-disciplinary engineering, testing, manufacturing, and supply chain deliverables are met on schedule, within cost constraints, and to contract specifications.

Working closely with the Program Chief Engineer, Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads, customers, and executive management, you will lead the strategic planning, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and daily execution across the entire program lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Program Execution & Lifecycle Management**

* Lead overall program execution from task award through design, development, hardware integration, production, and flight testing.
* Establish, maintain, and drive the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) aligning cross-functional engineering, procurement, and testing milestones.
* Direct program execution strategies across major formal milestones, including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), Flight Readiness Reviews (FRRs), and Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs).

**2. Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage overall program budget, cash flow, margins, and cost baselines.
* Monitor and report, and manage cost performance and schedule performance metrics.
* Author and submit formal customer financial and progress status reports.

**3. Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary operational and contractual point of contact for Project Management Offices (PMOs) and other customers.
* Lead formal program management reviews (PMRs) and executive briefings
* Manage customer expectations, scope modifications, engineering change proposals (ECPs), and contract additions.

**4. Risk Management & Cross-Functional Team Leadership**

* Establish and drive the Program Risk and Opportunity Management Board (ROMB) to proactively identify, quantify, and mitigate technical, schedule, supply chain, and financial risks.
* Partner with the Program Chief Engineer to balance technical trade-offs against schedule impacts and financial budgets.
* Oversee subcontractor management, major suppliers, and vendor deliverables in coordination with Global Supply Chain leadership.

**5. Flight Test & Range Logistics Oversight**

* Coordinate resource deployment, range access, and hardware availability for captive-carry, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL), and live-fire flight test campaigns.
* Ensure regulatory, range safety, and safety compliance across all flight operations and field deployments.

**Required Qualifications & Background**

* **Education:** B.S. in Engineering, Business Administration, Systems Management, or a related field (Formal acquisitions training and certification strongly preferred).
* **Experience:**
  + **5+ years** of direct experience as a Program Manager or Deputy PM managing complex hardware/software defense contracts.
* **Domain Mastery:**
  + Demonstrated track record managing defense development programs
  + In-depth understanding of DoW acquisition cycles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS), and defense contracting types (CPFF, FPIF, FFP).
  + Direct expertise utilizing advanced scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or Deltek Open Plan).
* **Security Clearance:** Must hold an **active US DoD Secret clearance**

**Desired Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or DAWIA Level III PM Certification.
* Prior experience managing ACAT I/II or major sub-system programs for the U.S. Department of War.
* Proven track record leading live-fire flight test programs or remote range deployments.
* Experience transitioning missile systems low-rate production.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Internal Project Manager / Risk Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
  
  
If you're energized by the idea of bringing structure to complexity — and by the knowledge that the projects, you support are helping power a cleaner world — this role is for you.
  
  
As a Internal Project Manager & Risk Manager within GE Vernova's North America Grid Solutions Integration (NAM GSI) Behind the Meter (BTM) portfolio, play a key role in driving execution discipline and operational efficiency across complex energy infrastructure projects. You'll work closely with Senior Project Managers/Project Directors, giving them the freedom to lead customer relationships while you'll strengthen internal project execution through cross-functional coordination, proactive risk management, process standardization, and continuous improvement. You'll also champion the adoption of digital and AI-driven solutions to simplify processes, enhance project visibility, and improve execution performance.
  
  
This is an opportunity to combine your project management expertise, analytical mindset, and Lean approach to make a tangible impact on project performance, grid reliability, and the future of energy.

**Job Description**
===================

**What You'll Do:**

  
  

**Execution & Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate cross-functional activities across engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, quality, logistics, and site teams to ensure alignment with approved project execution plans.
* Track action items, deliverables, and commitments — flagging deviations early, driving resolution of execution issues and ensuring timely closure.
* Support preparation and facilitation of internal project reviews, readiness reviews, and execution meetings.
  

  

**Risk & Opportunity Management**

* Lead and coordinate the risk and opportunity management process across an assigned group of projects, facilitating structured assessment sessions with Senior Project Managers, Project Directors, Project Controllers and cross-functional teams.
* Own the accuracy, completeness, and timely updates of Risk & Opportunity Registers, ensuring traceability and alignment with company risk management standards.
* Consolidate project-level risk data to deliver a clear sub-portfolio view of exposure, trends, and potential financial and schedule impacts.
* Monitor mitigation and opportunity realization actions, ensuring clear ownership and follow-up; escalate emerging or significant risks to project/portfolio leadership.
* Prepare and maintain risk dashboards and summaries to support leadership decisions and portfolio reviews.
  

  

**Financial & Commercial Support**

* Support budget tracking, commitments, and actuals in coordination with the Project Controller.
* Assist with Estimate at Completion (EAC) reviews, internal financial reporting, and change management documentation — without owning customer negotiations.
  

  

**Process Improvement & Digital Innovation**

* Champion the adoption of AI and digital tools in project management, identifying opportunities to automate routine activities, enhance risk analysis, and improve reporting efficiency.
* Drive lessons learned, best practices, process adherence, continuous improvement, and standardization initiatives across the portfolio.
  

  

**Stakeholder Interface**

* Serve as a key internal coordination point between project teams and factories for manufacturing follow-up, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) readiness, and delivery coordination.
* Participate in customer-facing meetings only when delegated, in a supporting capacity.

Clinglobal is an Animal Health Contract Research Organization (CRO) and member of the Clinglobal Group. We accelerate animal health innovation through a unique model that combines streamlined contracting, centralized project and program management, and a broad portfolio of preclinical, clinical, regulatory, data science, and laboratory services delivered by our group companies and strategic partners.

*Animals are our passion; people are our strength. Together, we better lives by accelerating animal health innovation.*

Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. The Senior Project Manager (SPM) plays a pivotal role in leading the internal day-to-day operations and delivery for a set of strategic, creative and medium-to-high complexity tactical projects, from inception to completion, within a brand or multiple brands. * Develops and actively manages project timelines, estimates, risk registers, communication plans, burn reports and change logs with minimal oversight
* Leads the estimation process and provides project budget and staff plan parameters with minimal supervision
* Leads the project timeline creation process in close partnership with internal and external stakeholders with minimal supervision

* Effectively senses team morale and understands how to address issues
* modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

* Three to five years of experience in a PMO role
* Pharmaceutical or advertising experience preferred (AOR or DAOR)

* Experience leading the delivery of complex, technology, strategy and creative based projects
* Ability to develop a creative, strategic or technical heavy project plan

Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.  
  
We are seeking an experienced Customer Program Manager to lead customer-facing programs for the Karman platform, from initial evaluation through pilot deployment, design win, and long-term adoption. This role combines program management discipline with strong customer engagement skills, acting as the single point of accountability across customers, Engineering, Product, Sales, and executive teams. * Establish trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders at technical, business, and executive levels, driving clarity in customer requirements and translating them into actionable internal deliverables.
* Coordinate joint planning sessions and program update meetings with customers throughout the Karman pilot lifecycle.
* Partner with Solutions Architects and Application Engineers to align resources for customer success, and interface with Product Management to relay customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities.

* Ensure Karman proof-of-concept, pilot, and deployment activities are executed successfully; track KPIs (adoption, performance, ROI) and communicate progress internally and externally.
* Manage change control across customer programs, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule integrity.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in program or project management, including timeline management, risk tracking, and reporting, ideally within a technology or hardware-adjacent environment.
* Strong customer communication and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to align technical execution with business outcomes.

**Salary Range:** $140,000 to $190,000 base compensation depending on experience, plus stock options. Salary will be commensurate with an individual's skills, training, years of experience, and in line with internal compensation bands.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike’s Intelligence Analysis Cell (IAC), a team within CrowdStrike Counter Adversary Operations (CAO), is seeking to hire a Senior Intelligence Analyst with high expertise in North Korea and the broader Asia-Pacific region.

The role specializes in conducting both investigative and contextual analysis related to cybersecurity threats posed by state-affiliated actors and hacktivists. This position is instrumental in providing answers to complex questions—such as “who” is behind the adversary and “why” the adversary behaves in a certain manner—through finished intelligence reports that are disseminated to CrowdStrike’s customers and stakeholders.

To support our mission, you will conduct Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) investigations that uncover the organizations, individuals, and policies that enable threat actors, providing insights into the behavior and motivations. You will also connect cyber activities to real-world events by examining how political, economic, and geopolitical factors influence or are influenced by adversarial operations.

**What You'll Do:**

* Conduct OSINT investigations into enabling entities that back DPRK state-sponsored adversaries
* Identify and track national and transnational developments that impact or are impacted by DPRK state-sponsored adversaries
* Compose short- and long-form finished intelligence reports
* Respond to customer requests for information (RFIs)
* Collaborate with other analysts, technical experts, and customer-facing personnel
* Strategize research prioritization efforts and intelligence gap identification

**What You'll Need:**

* The ability to read Korean with high proficiency
* A strong understanding of North Korean government bureaucracies pertinent to understanding the country's disposition towards the use of cyber operations; knowledge of the country's military, intelligence, and political organizations is particularly useful
* In-depth knowledge of North Korean and other regional states' foreign and domestic policies necessary to appropriately contextualize their behavior for various audiences
* A general understanding of North Korean and other Asia-Pacific cyber adversaries, including their major characteristics and relationships to government entities
* Excellent English writing and an ability to effectively explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences
* The ability to apply analytic best practices such as structured analysis, awareness of analyitical pitfalls, and critical thinking in source evaluation
* The ability to work collaboratively in a fully remote working environment
* Excellent time management skills and a high level of self accountability
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

* A nuanced understanding of the Korean language to include knowledge about country- and region-level dialects and technical terminology.

jobs.title: Global Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Zone Operating Model & Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance & Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM & Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

**CRM Data Quality & Pipeline Discipline**

* Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
* Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
* Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
* Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.

**Business Requirements Management**

* Collect, consolidate, and document zone-wide and country-specific business requirements.
* Assess alignment among country needs, zone priorities, and global standards, identifying opportunities for common solutions across countries.
* Coordinate zone-level prioritization and escalation of enhancement requests with country stakeholders.
* Coordinate review and approval of zone- and country-driven process changes.

**Exception & Change Control Management**

* Manage intake, triage, and documentation of country exception requests related to CRM processes, business rules, data standards, and operating procedures.
* Assess business impact, cross-country scalability, compliance considerations, and downstream reporting implications before escalating exceptions for approval.
* Maintain traceability of approved deviations and ensure they are reviewed periodically for continued relevance or harmonization back to the global standard.

**Zone & Country Readiness and Change Management**

* Work with zone and country stakeholders to coordinate training, communication, and awareness activities.
* Monitor readiness across the zone and identify country-level gaps, dependencies, and support needs for new capabilities and transformations.

Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

  

Motive is seeking a Senior Security Technical Program Manager to drive execution of the Security & Privacy Roadmap and other high-priority security risk-reduction programs. You will turn complex security and privacy goals into sequenced, measurable plans; align Security, Product, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and business partners; and make risks, dependencies, resourcing needs, and decisions visible to executives. You will play a central role in quarterly security planning and in preparing clear, evidence-based, board-ready updates.This role is well suited to a hands-on program leader who can move between technical detail and executive narrative—and who measures success by durable risk reduction and shipped outcomes, not activity alone.

* **Prepare executive and board materials:** Develop accurate, board-ready narratives and presentations that explain the risk, why it matters, progress against commitments, measurable outcomes, material changes, and decisions or investments required. Validate claims and metrics with accountable teams.
* **Build strong partnerships:** Align technical and nontechnical stakeholders, facilitate decisions when priorities conflict, and communicate with clarity at levels ranging from engineers to senior executives.
* **Improve the system:** Identify recurring delivery, governance, or measurement gaps and improve the security program operating model so teams can execute predictably and demonstrate control effectiveness.

### **What We’re Looking For:**

* 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, with meaningful experience in cybersecurity, product security, privacy, or a closely related risk-management domain.
* A track record of delivering multi-team programs across engineering and business functions, including work with senior leaders and teams that do not report to you.
* Strong program-management fundamentals: integrated plans, dependency and critical-path management, risk and issue resolution, capacity planning, change control, and outcome-based reporting.
* Ability to understand security architecture and control objectives well enough to ask precise questions, identify delivery and risk gaps, and translate technical details into business impact—without needing to be the hands-on implementer.
* Excellent executive writing and presentation skills; experience producing concise leadership updates or board-level materials grounded in verified evidence.
* Demonstrated an AI first mindset in executing programs vs manually chasing teams to get things done.
* Sound judgment in prioritizing risk, surfacing uncomfortable trade-offs, and balancing urgency, customer impact, compliance needs, and delivery capacity.
* A collaborative, low-ego approach and the ability to create accountability through influence, structure, and clear communication.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Familiarity with security and privacy programs such as IAM and authorization, vulnerability management, data lifecycle controls, incident remediation, audit readiness, or privacy engineering.
* Experience defining program metrics, risk indicators, control evidence, and executive dashboards.

jobs.description:

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting-edge technology and deep cross-border expertise, we deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and content and brand protection.

With over 700 experts operating across five continents, we are trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement at scale. From digital platforms to physical marketplaces, we help clients safeguard what matters most—everywhere it matters.

**Overview of the Role:**

As a Legal Operations Analyst, you will report to the Legal Operations Team Lead and process any intellectual property (IP) takedown requests, helping ensure our client continues to respect and uphold the intellectual property rights of all artists and creators. As part of the Legal Operations team, you will also support our client's responses to law enforcement and privacy requests.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Process large volumes of copyright and trademark takedown requests and counter-notifications
* Track all content removed pursuant to valid takedown requests
* Handle escalations related to the unauthorized use of content
* Work with our Trust & Safety team on IP related content moderation issues
* Identify areas to improve IP policies, processes, and technical tooling
* Draft response language to common IP questions and issue types
* Research industry standard practices for IP notice and takedown procedures
* Support Legal Operations team as needed across law enforcement and privacy related matters
* Occasionally participate in exigent on-call rotation during working hours

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Experience working in intellectual property operations, trust and safety, or customer experience
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to handle a high volume of legal document intake and processing
* Analytical approach to gathering and presenting data to inform decisions and the ongoing tracking of success metrics
* Strategic problem solving when finding opportunities for improvement
* Comfort with reviewing sensitive, explicit, and/or potentially disturbing content
* Knowledge of DMCA and Trademark law, as well as fair use
* Experience bringing or processing DMCA or Trademark requests for content removal
* Experience in law or policy within the Internet industry

**Why IP House:**

IP House is redefining how the world combats illicit trade and intellectual property theft—delivering scalable, end-to-end solutions that empower global brands and rights holders through innovation, strategic expertise, and a relentless commitment to global enforcement.

Achieving this ambitious mission requires the collaboration of an exceptionally talented team. We believe our people are the foundation of everything we do—and we invest accordingly. From day one, we foster a culture rooted in continuous learning, professional growth, and shared excellence.

We also understand that meaningful work begins with a strong foundation. That’s why we offer a flexible work environment and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a fast-scaling organization with a strong reputation for results—and room to grow with it. Join us in safeguarding the brands, content, and innovations that shape our world.

IP House is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

20 - 22 USD per hour(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Business Analyst / Functional Tester (CMS-HIOS)
jobs.description:
### **About Pluribus Digital:**

Join us and do work that matters: use your skills to improve how your government serves the public! Pluribus Digital partners with our government customers to design, develop, and deliver useful and impactful digital products. We are a hands-on digital services consultancy – part technologists, part change agents, and all heart. We employ modern best practices in all that we do as we work to solve problems in public health, financial industry regulation, granting citizenship and asylum, and identity and access management.

### **Role Description**

As a **Business Analyst / Functional Tester**, you will play a key role in supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS), a mission-critical federal application supporting the regulation and oversight of the health insurance marketplace. This role focuses on Operations & Maintenance (O&M), production support, user support, and incremental enhancements across numerous business modules.

Working within an Agile delivery team, you will collaborate closely with CMS stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, testers, architects, and operations personnel to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and verify, through hands-on functional testing, that what the team delivers meets those requirements. You'll own the work from requirement to validated feature, writing user stories and acceptance criteria and then testing completed work before it reaches CMS stakeholders. You will also support incident analysis, defect resolution, enhancement requests, business process improvements, and documentation efforts that enable the continued success of the system.

### **What You Will Do**

#### **Requirements & Analysis**

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements from CMS stakeholders and business users.
* Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business process documentation, workflow diagrams, and functional specifications.
* Analyze enhancement requests, production issues, and operational processes to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and user experience.
* Ensure requirements are complete, traceable, testable, and aligned with CMS objectives and governance standards.
* Maintain requirements and supporting documentation throughout the Agile delivery lifecycle.

#### **Manual & Functional Testing**

* Write and maintain test scenarios, test cases, and test data that trace directly to user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Test each story within the sprint and confirm it meets acceptance criteria before it is marked done.
* Log clear, reproducible defects with steps, expected vs. actual results, screenshots, and severity. Retest fixes and verify closure.
* Maintain a requirements traceability matrix and the test evidence that release and CMS governance reviews require.
* Do exploratory testing to find edge cases, usability problems, and gaps in requirements.
* Work with developers on defect triage and root cause, and with QA staff on test coverage and standards.

#### **Operations & Production Support**

* Support investigation and analysis of production issues, customer-reported defects, and operational questions.
* Collaborate with technical teams to reproduce issues, clarify expected system behavior, and document business impacts.
* Reproduce production issues in lower environments and confirm fixes before they are deployed.
* Assist with prioritization of defects and enhancement requests based on business value and operational needs.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities and recommend process or system improvements.
* Help maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, and user-facing documentation as system functionality evolves.

#### **Agile Delivery**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with Product Owners to refine and prioritize product backlogs.
* Ensure user stories contain sufficient business context and well-defined acceptance criteria.
* Prepare User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts, data, and environments. Guide CMS business users through UAT and track their findings to resolution.

#### **Stakeholder & Customer Engagement**

* Serve as a liaison between CMS business stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams.
* Facilitate requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.
* Communicate business needs, priorities, risks, and project status effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build collaborative relationships across multiple functional areas supporting the HIOS platform.

#### **Documentation & Process Improvement**

* Produce clear, concise documentation including business requirements, process flows, decision logs, release documentation, test plans and test results, and training materials.
* Assist with maintaining standard operating procedures and operational documentation.
* Recommend improvements to business processes, operational workflows, and support procedures based on data and stakeholder feedback.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a Moderate Risk Public Trust designation.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting enterprise software applications.
* 2+ years of hands-on manual or functional testing of web-based enterprise applications, including writing test cases and running regression tests.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and managing functional and business requirements.
* Experience logging and managing defects through their full lifecycle in Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar tool.
* Experience supporting Agile software delivery teams using Scrum or SAFe methodologies.
* Strong analytic

jobs.description:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

**\*\*\*Preference for a candidate in Dallas, TX - Hybrid 2 days/week.** **Will consider remote working CST hours\*\***  
  
Job Summary:  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on cloud security professional to join our team, bringing deep cloud infrastructure expertise and proven experience operating Cloud Security Posture Management and Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform solutions. This role blends platform administration, cloud security architecture, and direct remediation ownership, requiring someone who can not only identify risks but see findings through to resolution. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in complex, multi-account enterprise environments, communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and continuously looks for ways to improve security posture and operational efficiency.  
  
Responsibilities:  

* Onboard cloud accounts and workloads; manage platform configuration, policies, alerts, and coverage; troubleshoot permissions, connectivity, and data collection issues.
* Investigate misconfigurations, excessive IAM permissions, public exposure, and vulnerabilities; implement approved fixes and collaborate with application and infrastructure owners to validate closure.
* Contribute to secure cloud architecture and review infrastructure changes and DevSecOps pipelines for security gaps.
* Support cloud workload protection, container security, and threat detection across virtual machines, Kubernetes, and serverless workloads; coordinate incident response with security operations teams.
* Automate onboarding, reporting, and remediation workflows using APIs, scripts, and infrastructure as code; support integrations with Splunk and ServiceNow.
* Align security policies with organizational standards, CIS Benchmarks, and NIST guidance; tune alerts to reduce false positives and prioritize actionable risks.
* Produce dashboards and reports on coverage, security posture, vulnerabilities, and remediation progress.
* Independently coordinate across teams and vendors, maintain runbooks, share practical guidance, and drive continuous improvement of operational processes.

  
Skills:  

* Strong hands-on knowledge of AWS services spanning IAM, networking, compute, storage, logging, and encryption.
* Practical experience implementing, administering, or supporting a CSPM or CNAPP platform and remediating findings within the underlying cloud environment.
* Working knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, vulnerability management, and least-privilege access principles.
* Proficiency with Python or PowerShell, REST APIs, and infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills with the ability to work independently and drive remediation efforts across diverse teams.
* Preferred experience with Palo Alto Networks Cortex Cloud or Prisma Cloud, including onboarding, policy management, workload protection, integrations, or platform migration.
* Preferred experience in enterprise environments with multiple cloud accounts and compliance reporting requirements.

  
Qualifications:

* 3 + years of hands-on cloud engineering or security experience in an enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience administering or supporting a CSPM or CNAPP platform with direct ownership of finding remediation.
* Experience working across cross-functional teams including application owners, infrastructure teams, and security operations.
* Relevant cloud security certifications such as AWS Certified Security Specialty or equivalent are preferred.
* Palo Alto Networks certifications, including those related to Prisma Cloud or Cortex, are preferred.

  
This is a rare opportunity to take meaningful ownership of cloud security outcomes within a globally recognized organization, working at the intersection of engineering and security to protect a large-scale, dynamic cloud environment. You will have the autonomy to drive real change, build and refine processes from the ground up, and work alongside talented teams who are equally committed to excellence. If you are passionate about cloud security and want a role where your contributions are visible and impactful, this is the opportunity for you.

**Pay Rate Range**

33 - 39 USD hourly

Today it is the central fundraising organization for the UH System and is contracted by the Board of Regents to be the sole provider of fundraising and alumni services. In addition to fundraising, the Foundation manages more than 7,000 gift accounts for the benefit of the university and its students.

The UH Foundation is a private, institutionally related corporation designated as a 501(c)(3) organization by the Internal Revenue Service. It is a legally separate entity from UH, the UH Alumni Association, and all other UH affiliates. However, the UH Foundation works closely with these organizations, as well as with others in the community, exclusively for the benefit of the university.

Our Vision

To inspire giving and partnership with UH by fostering UH pride and passion among donors, alumni and the community.

Our Mission

To unite donors' passions with UH's aspirations by raising philanthropic support and managing private investments to benefit UH, the people of Hawaiʻi and our future generations.

Our Values

Our values shape our relationships and guide our thinking and actions. By living our values, we build trust with our fellow employees, our donors, the university and the broader community.

**Position Overview:**
======================

Amatriot is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst to support a Cyber Technical Analysis Unit in analyzing cyber intrusion activity, digital communications, and host/network forensic artifacts in support of DoJ mission operations.

This role is focused on cyber threat analysis, intrusion investigation, host-based forensic analysis, network traffic analysis, and attribution support within a highly sensitive operational environment.

The ideal candidate will possess experience analyzing Splunk data, conducting host and network forensic analysis, and utilizing industry-standard forensic and cyber analysis tools to identify malicious activity, recover artifacts, and support investigative operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Cyber Threat Analysis and Intrusion Investigation**

* Process, evaluate, and analyze digital network communications and cyber threat data to identify malicious activity and support investigative operations.
* Conduct cyber intrusion investigations and end-to-end kill chain analysis across host and network environments.
* Correlate digital artifacts, including IP addresses, URLs, malware indicators, system logs, and user activity across multiple data sources to support attribution and investigative lead generation.
* Support attribution and operational analysis by correlating threat indicators and investigative data.

### **Host-Based Forensic Analysis**

* Perform host-based forensic analysis leveraging Splunk and standard forensic toolsets to identify indicators of compromise, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and unauthorized access.
* Analyze encrypted and plaintext credentials, registry artifacts, rootkit activity, command-line execution, and other system-level forensic evidence.
* Recover artifacts to support investigative operations.

### **Network Traffic Analysis**

* Analyze packet capture and NetFlow data to identify malicious communications, software usage, command execution, credential activity, and network-based indicators of compromise.

### **Reporting, Process Development, and Quality Assurance**

* Draft detailed technical reports and analytical findings based on cyber investigations.
* Participate in internal review and quality assurance processes.
* Support development and refinement of cyber analysis processes, CONOPS, SOPs, and investigative methodologies.
* Provide operational updates and analytical findings to leadership and investigative stakeholders.

### **Threat Research and Mission Collaboration**

* Conduct open-source and intelligence community research to maintain awareness of emerging cyber threats, malware trends, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.

* Advanced certifications, specialized training, or equivalent hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of years of experience.

### **Experience**

* Experience performing host-based forensic analysis utilizing Splunk.
* Experience analyzing network traffic, packet capture, and NetFlow data.
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard forensic tools such as:
  + Splunk
  + EnCase
  + Magnet AXIOM
  + X-Ways Forensics
* Experience correlating threat indicators and investigative data to support attribution and operational analysis.

### **Skills**

* Understanding of cyber intrusion methodologies, attacker kill chains, malware behavior, and forensic artifact analysis.

### **Clearance**

* Active Top Secret clearance required, with willingness and ability to obtain a Counterintelligence Polygraph.

jobs.title: AV & IT Project Manager, Workplace Solutions
jobs.description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.  
  
At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.  
  
*This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.*

**Position Summary**
====================

The Workplace Audio Visual & IT Project Manager is responsible for the efficient, effective, and flawless execution of AV and IT technology projects with minimal disruption and consistent principles. This role is a leader in the management of projects from start to finish, including preliminary planning, project strategy development, high-level estimation, design, pre-construction, detailed estimation, installation and commissioning, and post-project documentation completion. This role is also responsible for ownership and governance of Workplace Technologies, systems used to support the entire Workplace Solutions team.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Work with business stakeholders, IT, and AV integration partners to evaluate feasibility and potential challenges of upcoming AV/IT projects.
* Develop strategic plan, timeline, programming, and major requirements for upcoming AV and IT deployments.
* Prepare high-level estimates and detailed budgets and partner with Finance to prepare packages for capital approvals for various project stages.
* Partner with Nestlé North America Procurement creating Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and solicit bids for projects; evaluate bids, present findings, and deliver recommendations to Workplace Solutions Leadership, IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Legal, and Safety teams.
* Partner with in-house staff, design, AV integrators, and technology suppliers on developing final technology layouts; evaluate workplace requirements and special AV areas required for the business.
* Ensure all required permits, Certificates of Insurance, and necessary approvals are obtained.
* Update the project schedule, budgets, and drawing log and lead regular progress meetings with vital partner teams.
* Ensure timely processing of integrator, subcontractor, hardware, software, and licensing invoices and vendor applications
* Write all AV/IT-related RFPs, contracts, purchase orders, and change orders; maintain a record of field work and change orders and their impact upon job cost and the project schedule.
* Obtain, assemble, distribute, and file all as-built drawings, technology standards documentation for records, warranties, end user license agreements, and final closeout materials.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned
* Workplace Technology Ownership & Governance
* Own and manage workplace technology platforms and applications, including planning, vendor management, governance, user adoption, lifecycle management and continuous improvement.
* Serve as primary liaison between Workplace Solutions, IT, Security, vendors and business stakeholders.
* Monitor service performance, platform utilization, and vendor effectiveness
* Lead operational escalations and issue resolution for workplace technology services.
* Define and maintain technology standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security, compliance and employee experience objectives.

**Employee Experience and In-Office Support**

* Ensure seamless delivery of meeting room AV technology and conferencing services, with accountability for reliability, readiness, and user experience across supported locations.
* Oversee day-to-day meeting technology operations, including coordination with on-site meeting support staff, vendors, IT partners, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain service continuity.
* Provide support for AV planning and execution for large events, executive meetings, town halls, and high-visibility gatherings, including pre-event testing, live support, escalation management, and post-event review.
* Monitor and own streaming and hybrid meeting support for meetings and events across U.S. market locations, ensuring consistent standards, appropriate support coverage, and timely issue resolution.
* Manage conference room accounts, standards, and technology experience, including room configuration, service expectations, lifecycle planning, and alignment with enterprise collaboration tools.
* Provide employee support and guidance as needed for meeting technology, conferencing tools, and workplace AV services to support effective collaboration and a positive employee experience.

**Requirements**
================

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Audio Visual Technology, Electronics, or Engineering or related degree.
* 5+ years of project management work experience in AV systems integration, IT infrastructure deployment, or corporate technology delivery.
* Experience with AV/IT deployments for Corporate Offices, Factories, and Distribution Centers, including knowledge of commercial AV control, networking, and conferencing technologies (e.g. Microsoft Teams Rooms).
* Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office (Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook) and Microsoft Project.
* Ability to read and interpret AV drawings, scopes of work, and construction drawings.
* PMP certification preferred; CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) required within 180 days of employment.
* Willing and able to travel up to 20%.

jobs.description:
*Turn warehouse data into the decisions that keep high-tech supply chains moving.* ***This position is based in Virginia and is NOT REMOTE***

The Dulles corridor runs on data. From the data centers of Loudoun County to the air cargo moving through Dulles Airport, this region is where logistics and technology meet, and this role sits right at that intersection.

At Arnoff, our partner Dulles facility supports a forward stocking location for a leading technology customer, where the right part in the right place at the right time really matters. We are looking for a Warehouse Data Analyst who loves clean numbers, sharp reports, and finding the story hiding in a spreadsheet. You will be the person that we rely on to know exactly what is on hand, what shipped, and how we are performing.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE

* **Real impact, fast. Your reports go straight to program managers, supervisors, and Finance, and they drive daily decisions, customer scorecards, and billing.**
* **Room to build.** We want recurring reports to be automated. If you like that automation, you will have a real playground to put it to work.
* **Be the go-to person.** You will serve as Arnoff's representative and main point of contact at the facility, and you will train teammates on our reports and systems.
* **Learn the whole operation.** You will get hands-on with the warehouse floor so your analysis is grounded in how the work actually happens, which is great experience for a career in supply chain analytics or program management. **Inventory experience preferred in a manufacturing setting.**
* **A schedule that fits life.** Weekday daytime hours with overtime eligibility, in a location that is easy to reach from Loudoun, western Fairfax, and the Route 28 corridor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the reporting rhythm

* Run and distribute assigned reports, including on-hand inventory and requested transactional reports.
* Run the shipment and location reports that set the Supervisor up for the day.
* Compile and enter milestone data for the daily milk run.
* Prepare weekly and monthly cycle count reports for the Program Manager.

Power the numbers that matter

* Build the data behind scorecard updates and KPI, SLA, volume, and spend reporting.
* Provide billing data to the Program Manager and Finance every billing cycle.
* Supply controllable-error data to support warehouse performance reviews.
* Spot data discrepancies and flag them to the Supervisor for correction.

Make it better

* Automate recurring reports and keep report documentation current.
* Train staff on reports and system use.
* Serve as Arnoff's main point of contact at the facility and support project management as needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

* A bachelor's degree in analytics, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years in reporting or analytics, ideally in warehousing or logistics.
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, lookups). Power BI or Tableau is a big plus.
* Experience pulling and reconciling data from existing systems.
* A working understanding of inventory concepts like shrinkage, cycle counts, and on-hand buckets.
* Clear, accurate writing that turns findings into actionable insights.

Bonus points if you have military logistics, supply, or 3PL experience, or if you can't leave a broken formula alone.

**Location**

**On-site in Dulles, VA, close to Route 28, the Dulles Toll Road, and Washington Dulles International Airport ( no relocation opportunities available)**

Schedule

Weekdays, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (40 hours, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch). No nights, no weekends.

Hourly, overtime-eligible (non-exempt)

**$32 - $36 per Hour**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account

* Paid time off
* Parental leave

* Vision insurance

Work Location: Dulles, Virginia

At the center of our company culture is a commitment to instilling a dynamic and employee-friendly place to work. The incumbent will leverage domain expertise, advanced analytics, and research methodologies to transform complex healthcare data into actionable insights. * Conduct research on best practices and analyze diverse Medicaid and Children’s Health Insurance Program (CHIP) data sources including claims, TAF, program oversight metrics, scorecards, and performance data to identify patterns, clusters, and insights that inform policy, operational improvements, and feature development for CMS business needs.

Four years of specialized experience may substitute for a bachelor’s degree.
* Experience applying statistical methods including distributions, hypothesis testing, regression and conducting complex data analyses with visualization techniques to support data-driven decision-making for program administration, policymaking, and oversight.

* Subject matter expertise in text analytics is preferred and experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques using Python or similar technologies is a plus.
* Proficiency in Python and R is a plus.
* Prior experience with Center for Medicare Medicaid Services (CMS) or other Gov’t agencies is a plus.
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.

**JOB SUMMARY**

This position is located in the Central Detention Facility (CDF) or the Correctional Treatment Facility (CTF), located at 1901 D Street, SE Washington, DC. This position is located in the D.C. Department of Corrections (DOC), Deputy Director for Administration, Cluster Accreditation and Compliance Unit.

The DOC is mandated by the District of Columbia Council to achieve and maintain accreditation by the American Correctional Association (ACA), a national governing body. This position is responsible for carrying out parts of the accreditation process and has a critical impact on the operation of the facility.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Supports the Audit Compliance Manager in creating program management assessment guidelines/policies, conducts periodic audits/evaluations as well as follow-up on adherence monitoring with the Agency to determine staff performance, compliance with applicable policy procedures, and standards, and administration of external contract services. Serves as agency liaison for the ACA applicants, pre-audit, correspondent, candidates, audits, and accreditation hearing process. Plans and organizes, conducts, and documents scheduled inspections to ensure that operations and programs are accomplished and in compliance as outlined in the policy and procedures; and represents the institution or program before the Commission on Accreditation at panel hearing for re-accreditation; assists with developing management operations assessment criteria for the Compliance and Accreditation Office.

Coordinates aspects of the program audit/evaluation, including interviews, gathering facts, and other date reviewing a wide variety of records and reports, analyzing data and determining the sufficiency, reliability and relevance of evidence used to support the conclusions and recommendation for approval implementation. Provides advisory services on identified problem area with agency program managers, prepares written reports that address findings and recommendations and develops and maintains an effective follow up system to assure responsive and timely replies to audit/evaluation reports and the appropriate corrective actions are taken in a timely manner.

To be creditable, at least one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

None.

Work is typically performed in an office environment; however, special safety precautions and clothing may be utilized during performance of safety and security inspections involving facilities, apparatus, tools and equipment, etc. Incumbent will routinely visit and inspect correctional facilities including secure inmate housing areas.

A TB Test is required prior to entry on duty.

  + Bachelor’s Degree preferred

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Must have the ability to demonstrate strong business and organizational skills and have outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written.
