jobs.title: Program Analyst Associate
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618264

**Location:** Washington, DC, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-22

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Project Analyst

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 25% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** None

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** Secret

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

As an **Associate Program Analyst**, the candidate will support Test and Evaluation (T&E) of Foreign Military Sales (FMS) AEGIS surface ships and weapons systems for Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Mission Systems [formerly PEO IWS] at the Navy Yard in Washington, DC. Oversees and manages the operational aspects of ongoing projects and serves as liaison between project management and planning, project team, and line management. Reviews status of projects and budgets; manages schedules and prepares status reports. Assesses project issues and develops resolutions to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals and objectives. Develops mechanisms for monitoring project progress and for intervention and problem solving with project managers, line managers, and clients.

Your work will contribute to the successful at-sea testing of new construction and modernized AEGIS combat systems and ships for various US Navy International Partners. Your work will include understanding system capabilities; identifying requirements for at-sea testing; translating capabilities and test requirements to Test Objectives; using the Planning, Execution, Analysis, and Reporting (PEAR) process to develop test scenarios to evaluate Test Objectives; defining and validating resources needed to meet test scenario requirements; advising the test execution team during scenario execution; and ensuring data collection and analysis plans support reporting requirements. You will provide program office administrative and engineering support in the development of FMS cases. This project will include working on a team with senior engineers and program office personnel.

Support roles will include planning and delivering multi agency meetings to include presentation material, overall coordination, and tracking and closing action associated from the meetings. You will be required to maintain Confluence and Jira Project planning material. Assistance will be given to the program office representative to create and promulgate budgeting material. Prior US Navy or military experience is preferable ,but not required as self starters can be very effective in the job, so a lack of USN or military background should not discourage from applying.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline (Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field); In lieu of a technical degree, a minimum of 4 years of relevant U.S. Navy technical experience is required and acceptable.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information into clear test documentation and requirements.
* The position requires occasional travel to FMS countries such as Japan, South Korea, Australia or Spain to visit US test ranges or warfare centers.
* Ability to obtain an Interim Secret clearance or currently hold an active Secret clearance.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Relevant experience includes Navy ratings such as Fire Controlman (FC), Electronics Technician (ET), AEGIS Display Technician (ADTT), Operations Specialist (with AEGIS console experience), or other roles directly supporting AEGIS Combat Systems or shipboard combat system operations.
* Prior US Navy or military experience is preferable ,but not required as self starters can be very effective in the job, so a lack of USN or military background should not discourage from applying.
* Previous hands-on experience with the AEGIS Weapon System, either aboard ship or in a test, training, or integration environment.
* Technical background in combat systems, fire control, radar systems, electronic warfare, or naval systems integration.
* Familiarity with Test & Evaluation processes such as test planning, scenario development, data analysis, or operational testing.
* Experience using JIRA and Confluence for project or test management.
* Understanding of DoD acquisition processes or prior experience supporting NAVSEA, PEO IWS, or PAE Mission Systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, test officers, and program office personnel.

Target salary range: $40,001 - $80,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

jobs.title: Talent Program Manager
jobs.description:
**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Talent Program Manager to join a cross-functional group of operators and specialists who are responsible for executing on people initiatives that support Palantir's talented employees, work, and values. Our mandate is broad, and you'll work on projects that span People Experience operational responsibilities as well as internal events, new hire onboarding, and logistics support.
  
  
As a Talent Program Manager, you’ll work with other program managers to support initiatives across People Experience, Events, and Learning. You’ll host Indoc, our new-hire program, in London about every other week and partner with company leaders to improve the program and showcase great work across the business. You’ll also help keep key People Experience projects on track by improving processes, clearing roadblocks, and anticipating what stakeholders need. This role suits someone who enjoys solving problems, bringing structure to ambiguity, and learning from good ideas, wherever they come from. The team and its work are still evolving, so flexibility and a willingness to pick up new skills are important.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Facilitate new hire onboarding in-person in our London office every other week (on average)
* Own operational workflows across the People Experience team, spanning new hire onboarding, learning programs, and internal events both on and offsite
* Work directly with external stakeholders, as well as internal teams (e.g. Finance, Procurement, Legal, Information Security, etc.) to coordinate the full life cycle for event logistics, contracts, and payments
* Leverage new product and artificial intelligence to scale team’s operational reach

### **What We Value**

* Comfortable facilitating large events, with the ability to command a room of 20-200+ attendees
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders while building positive working relationships
* Strong organization and problem-solving skills. You should be able to anticipate challenges and complications, multitask in a rapidly-changing environment, and use good judgement in making appropriate tradeoffs when executing on competing priorities.
* A creative approach to project management centered around lightweight frameworks that enable rapid iteration and low-overhead methods of keeping our partnering teams informed
* Strong attention to detail, including maintaining accurate records and diligently tracking key project metrics and reporting

### **What We Require**

* 2+ years experience in an operational role, preferably in a fast-paced or dynamic environment
* Ability and willingness to be onsite 5 days per week

**Life at Palantir**

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

jobs.description:
**Hello. We’re Teya.**

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

**Teya exists to change that.**

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

**Senior Data Analyst – Enterprise Risk**
=========================================

**The role**
------------

Teya is building its Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and strengthening how risk information is brought together, analysed and reported across the business.

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in turning risk data into reliable measures, meaningful insights and actionable reporting. You'll work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and stakeholders across Credit, Fraud, AML, People, IT, Operations and Finance to understand the risks facing the business, identify the right data to monitor them, and develop effective reporting and early-warning capabilities.

This is a business-facing analytical role. Understanding risk, working effectively with risk owners and translating their requirements into practical data solutions will be just as important as your technical skills. You'll help ensure key risk indicators (KRIs) are meaningful, data is reliable, thresholds are appropriately informed by analysis, and reporting supports better risk oversight and decision-making.

You'll also help modernise how risk reporting is produced, using AI models and workflow automation to bring together internal data and relevant external information, identify emerging issues and reduce manual effort. The focus is on practical application, with robust validation, traceability and human oversight.

This is an opportunity to combine risk expertise, analytical problem-solving and emerging AI capabilities to help shape how a growing fintech business identifies, monitors and manages risk.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Develop risk data and reporting:** Identify and map relevant data sources, using tools such as Snowflake to build repeatable datasets for KRIs across operational, credit, fraud, AML, people, capital, liquidity and other risk categories.
* **Partner with risk stakeholders:** Work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and risk owners across the business to understand their priorities, clarify reporting requirements and translate risk management needs into practical analytical solutions.
* **Analyse and monitor risk indicators:** Use SQL and Python to investigate trends, test assumptions, identify anomalies and understand changes in risk exposure. Help risk owners interpret findings and determine where further investigation or action may be needed.
* **Support KRI definitions and thresholds:** Work with risk stakeholders to validate indicator definitions, assess data quality and analyse historical and current performance to inform threshold calibration. Help ensure indicators provide meaningful insight into the risks they are intended to monitor.
* **Build dashboards and management reporting:** Develop clear, accessible dashboards using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools, supporting monthly ERMF reporting and management oversight.
* **Automate risk reporting with AI:** Build and improve AI-enabled workflows that bring together internal data and relevant external signals, including regulatory updates, market developments, news and emerging threats. Help generate evidence-based reporting drafts for review by the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and CRO.
* **Develop early-warning capabilities:** Help design and test approaches to monitor KRI movements and operational data throughout the month, highlighting unusual patterns and potential emerging risks with clear supporting evidence for investigation.
* **Support risk technology and integration:** Translate ERMF and reporting requirements into practical data, integration and workflow specifications for Teya's governance, risk and compliance (GRC) solution, partnering with Risk, Data and Technology colleagues on implementation.
* **Improve data quality and governance:** Document data sources, definitions, lineage, refresh frequencies, validation checks and limitations to ensure reporting is consistent, explainable and reliable.
* **Drive continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, improve analytical processes and strengthen how risk information is used across the business.

**Role: Business Analyst – Office of the CIO, Risk & SMF 24 (6 Month FTC)**

**Location: London / Hybrid**

**Position: Full time, Fixed Term Contract**

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to support the design and implementation of the future operating model for the Office of the CIO, with a particular focus on technology risk management, governance, controls and SMF24 compliance.

This is a hands-on transformation role requiring someone who can work across Technology, Risk and senior stakeholders to translate regulatory and risk-management requirements into a practical and sustainable operating model.

The role will help define how the Office of the CIO operates in BAU, including its governance structure, accountabilities, decision rights, risk and control processes, management information, committee framework and escalation routes.

The successful candidate will combine strong business analysis and target operating model experience with practical knowledge of technology/operational risk, governance and the Senior Managers & Certification Regime (SM&CR).

**About the Job**

**What you’ll spend your time doing**

Operating Model & Governance

* Support the design of the target operating model for the Office of the CIO.
* Assess current governance, risk, control and reporting arrangements and identify gaps against the required future state.
* Define future-state capabilities, processes, roles, responsibilities, decision rights and operating procedures.
* Establish clear interfaces between Technology, the Office of the CIO, Risk, Compliance and other governance functions.
* Develop governance structures, committee arrangements and Terms of Reference, including membership, decision rights, escalation routes and reporting requirements.
* Support implementation and transition of the new operating model into BAU.

Risk Management & Controls

* Support the development of the CIO/Technology Risk Management Framework and associated standards.
* Define risk ownership, control ownership, risk processes and governance requirements.
* Develop clear accountability across Lines 1, 1.5 and 2, including RACIs and escalation routes.
* Review existing risk and control processes, identifying gaps, duplication and unclear accountability.
* Support the definition of risk identification, assessment, acceptance, monitoring and reporting processes.
* Ensure risk and control information is effectively incorporated into CIO governance and management reporting.

SMF24 & Regulatory Governance

* Translate SMF24 responsibilities and accountabilities into effective governance, processes, controls and management information.
* Map SMF24 accountabilities to governance forums, controls, decision rights and escalation routes.
* Develop responsibility and accountability mapping that demonstrates clear ownership and oversight.
* Support the establishment and mobilisation of governance forums required to support SMF24 responsibilities.
* Ensure the operating model supports appropriate governance evidence and demonstrable management oversight.

Business Analysis

* Facilitate workshops with Technology, Risk and senior stakeholders.
* Elicit, analyse and document business, governance and regulatory requirements.
* Produce current and future-state process maps, RACIs, capability models and operating model documentation.
* Perform gap and impact assessments.
* Translate complex risk, regulatory and technology concepts into clear, concise documentation.
* Develop options and recommendations to support senior management decisions.

We are looking for someone who can operate at the intersection of technology, risk, regulation and operating-model design.

You should be comfortable moving from high-level operating model discussions with senior stakeholders into the detail of processes, controls, RACIs, governance forums and management information.

Most importantly, you will bring a pragmatic mindset. The objective is not simply to document regulatory requirements, but to turn them into clear, workable governance and risk-management arrangements that can be embedded successfully into BAU.

Essential

* Strong Business Analyst experience within financial services or another highly regulated environment.

* Practical experience of technology risk, operational risk, governance and controls.
* Working knowledge of SM&CR, ideally including direct exposure to SMF24.

* Experience designing governance structures, Terms of Reference and committee arrangements.
* Strong understanding of the Three Lines model and the interaction between first and second-line risk functions.
* Experience creating process maps, RACI/accountability matrices, governance frameworks and control documentation.
* Strong workshop facilitation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior Technology and Risk stakeholders.

Desirable

* Bachelor’s degree in a related area or an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

* Extensive knowledge of DD Form 254 implementation within the Air Force acquisition lifecycle.
* Proven experience conducting risk assessments, developing OPSEC plans, and providing detailed security classification guidance.

* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic environment while effectively interacting with DoD, military, civilian, and industry partners.

jobs.description:
**Description**

Ria Money Transfer, a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT), delivers innovative financial services including fast, secure, and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers along with currency exchange, mobile top-up, bill payment and check cashing services, offering a reliable omnichannel experience. With over 600,000 locations in nearly 200 countries and territories, our purpose remains to open ways for a better everyday life.

We believe we can create a world in which people are empowered to build the life they dream of no matter who they are or where they are. One customer, one family, one community at a time

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

We are seeking a Wallet & Card Program Manager to lead the strategy, design, and technical implementation of our digital wallet, deposit account and debit card programs in the United States. This role sits at the intersection of product, payments technology, and U.S. banking regulation, and will own the end-to-end lifecycle of wallet and card solutions — from product vision through sponsor bank, processor and network integration, to launch and optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with hands-on understanding of sponsor bank (BaaS) programs, card issuing and U.S. payment rails, digital wallets and core banking integrations

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for Deposit Accounts (checking and savings), Debit Cards, and Digital Wallet capabilities, aligning with company growth strategy, U.S. regulatory requirements, and market opportunities
* Continuously evaluate U.S. market trends, competitive neobank and fintech offerings, and customer needs to identify opportunities for new product features and monetization models (interchange, subscriptions, deposit economics).
* Design and oversee the end-to-end card and wallet ecosystem architecture, integrating internal systems with sponsor bank, core banking/processor, card network and other fintech partner platforms
* Drive end-to-end testing and validation to ensure Accounts and Card functionalities operate seamlessly across all platforms during each product implementation and release
* Prioritize initiatives and maintain a structured product backlog and delivery roadmap balancing regulatory, operational, and customer experience needs.
* Gather and prioritize requirements from internal stakeholders including business, operations, compliance, and customer support
* Define functional requirements and translate business requirements into clear product specifications for core banking capabilities supporting deposit accounts and cards
* Drive innovation in wallet functionality, including card controls, real-time payments (RTP / FedNow), ACH and direct deposit, tokenized payments (Apple Pay / Google Pay), APY-bearing savings, remote check deposit, cash load networks and integration with cross-border remittance.
* Manage strategic relationships with sponsor banks, card schemes (e.g., Visa / Mastercard), card processors, and other payment infrastructure providers
* Partner with Compliance, Legal and the sponsor bank to ensure programs meet U.S. requirements, including Regulation E, Regulation DD, Regulation II (Durbin), BSA/AML, OFAC, FDIC pass-through insurance, CFPB/UDAAP expectations and card network operating rules
* Define and manage the full product lifecycle of Deposit Account and Card products
* Ensure operational teams have the processes, tools, and documentation needed to support payment products effectively
* Ensure strong program governance, tracking delivery progress, managing risks, and ensuring timely resolution of blockers

**COMPETENCIES**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution mindset
* Strong technical fluency
* Structured program management
* Data-driven decision making
* Vendor management expertise
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* 5+ years in fintech, payments, or digital banking, ideally in the U.S. market
* Hands-on experience with U.S. debit card issuing programs and digital wallet integrations
* Experience working with sponsor banks / Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) partners, third-party processors and core banking platforms
* Working knowledge of U.S. payment rails (ACH, RTP / FedNow, debit networks) and consumer banking regulation (Reg E, Reg DD, Reg II, BSA/AML)
* Ability to translate strategy into scalable products
* This is a high-impact role for someone who can bridge product vision and technical execution to build best-in-class wallet and card experiences

PERKS & BENEFITS

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401K Plan with Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Vacation / Sick Leave
* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Tuition Assistance
* Growth Opportunities
* Corporate gatherings, team bonding events, and much more!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

  

Motive is seeking a Senior Security Technical Program Manager to drive execution of the Security & Privacy Roadmap and other high-priority security risk-reduction programs. You will turn complex security and privacy goals into sequenced, measurable plans; align Security, Product, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and business partners; and make risks, dependencies, resourcing needs, and decisions visible to executives. You will play a central role in quarterly security planning and in preparing clear, evidence-based, board-ready updates.This role is well suited to a hands-on program leader who can move between technical detail and executive narrative—and who measures success by durable risk reduction and shipped outcomes, not activity alone.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Own roadmap execution:** Maintain the integrated Security & Privacy Roadmap from intake and prioritization through delivery and operational handoff. Clarify scope, accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and success measures across concurrent initiatives.
* **Drive risk-reduction programs:** Lead cross-functional execution of major security programs, which may include identity and access management, authorization, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection and retention, privacy controls, and security assurance. * **Lead quarterly planning:** Coordinate planning inputs, capacity and sequencing discussions, prioritization trade-offs, and commitments. Surface gaps early, distinguish committed work from aspirational work, and bring options and recommendations to decision-makers.
* **Establish operating rigor:** Run effective program reviews and maintain concise plans, RAID logs, decision records, and dashboards. Track leading indicators and delivery milestones; escalate blockers with clear impact, owner, and recommended next step.
* **Prepare executive and board materials:** Develop accurate, board-ready narratives and presentations that explain the risk, why it matters, progress against commitments, measurable outcomes, material changes, and decisions or investments required. Validate claims and metrics with accountable teams.
* **Build strong partnerships:** Align technical and nontechnical stakeholders, facilitate decisions when priorities conflict, and communicate with clarity at levels ranging from engineers to senior executives.
* **Improve the system:** Identify recurring delivery, governance, or measurement gaps and improve the security program operating model so teams can execute predictably and demonstrate control effectiveness.

### **What We're Looking For:**

* 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, with meaningful experience in cybersecurity, product security, privacy, or a closely related risk-management domain.

* Strong program-management fundamentals: integrated plans, dependency and critical-path management, risk and issue resolution, capacity planning, change control, and outcome-based reporting.
* Ability to understand security architecture and control objectives well enough to ask precise questions, identify delivery and risk gaps, and translate technical details into business impact—without needing to be the hands-on implementer.
* Excellent executive writing and presentation skills; experience producing concise leadership updates or board-level materials grounded in verified evidence.
* Demonstrated an AI first mindset in executing programs vs manually chasing teams to get things done.
* Sound judgment in prioritizing risk, surfacing uncomfortable trade-offs, and balancing urgency, customer impact, compliance needs, and delivery capacity.
* A collaborative, low-ego approach and the ability to create accountability through influence, structure, and clear communication.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in a SaaS or technology company with complex products, customer data, and cross-functional security ownership.
* Familiarity with security and privacy programs such as IAM and authorization, vulnerability management, data lifecycle controls, incident remediation, audit readiness, or privacy engineering.
* Experience defining program metrics, risk indicators, control evidence, and executive dashboards.

* High-priority security programs deliver agreed milestones and demonstrable risk reduction, with exceptions and residual risk explicitly documented.

* Cross-functional partners have a reliable operating cadence and clear visibility into status, trade-offs, and next

Specifically, the People Data Review Program Manager will be responsible for driving and delivering end-to-end assessments of employment and privacy risk in new and novel use cases impacting People Data.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, People Risk & Assurance Responsibilities:**

* Execute comprehensive risk assessments for employment and people data privacy risks for projects and products involving people data at the company

* Manage cross-functional dependencies, risks, and changes effectively by optimizing scope, schedule, and resources accordingly
* Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions, including reducing the manual efforts through automation
* Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, and ensure people compliance is not compromised
* Manage relationships both internal and external to the Meta People organization
* Communicate clearly and build alignment with stakeholders across teams to drive program outcomes, and team player attitude with a bias to action
* Identify, assess, and remediate people data risk issues by analyzing data, coordinating with stakeholders, and implementing mitigation plans

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in implementing and supporting a comprehensive risk assessment program involving security, privacy, and/or employment compliance
* 8+ years of experience leading key projects or initiatives in a scaled, cross-functional program involving sensitive or regulated data
* Experience conducting or overseeing privacy risk assessments or data protection impact assessments for workforce or HR data systems
* Experience partnering with Legal, Employment Law, or HR functions to navigate complex data privacy requirements
* Experience in developing and implementing scalable governance frameworks, policies, or processes for sensitive data handling
* Have working knowledge or the willingness to quickly learn the content and requirements of various employment laws, regulations, industry guidance, and company compliance policies
* Experience maintaining open, candid, and trusting work relationships with both product and engineering teams and with legal partners

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated skills in using AI tools, applications, or skills to monitor and inform operational health and business priorities
* Advanced degree in AI or security

**LiveX AI · Project Manager**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, on-site · Department: Operations / Deployments · Reports to: founding team  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/project-manager (posted Jul 24, 2026)

### **About the Role**

LiveX AI builds AI infrastructure for the physical world, deploying interactive AI agents and hardware into high-foot-traffic venues such as hotels, retail flagships, convention centers, and stadiums. Each deployment is custom and requires sales, solution engineering, warehouse readiness, and a third-party delivery partner to stay in sync. This role owns each deployment end to end and works daily with sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics.

### **Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Deployment Ownership**

* Single accountable owner for each deployment, from signed contract to a live, working installation at the customer site.
* Run the deployment schedule: define milestones, sequence dependencies, track status, surface risks and blockers early.
* Internal hub across sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics so nothing falls between teams.

**Scope & Solution Engineering**

* Drive a clear, complete SOW from sales and sales engineering before each deployment starts; push back when scope is ambiguous.
* Track solution engineers through implementation against the SOW, keeping configuration and readiness on schedule.
* Translate customer requirements and site constraints into a concrete deployment plan.

**Logistics & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate with the office/logistics owner and the third-party delivery partner on delivery windows, pickup, and destination readiness.
* Confirm warehouse readiness before each deployment: items staged, configured, health-checked before shipping.
* Manage installation scheduling and any returns or de-installations.

**Customer & Communication**

* Customer-facing point of contact during rollout: set expectations, communicate timelines, manage change requests.
* Run deployment kickoffs and post-deployment reviews; capture lessons; feed improvements into the playbook.
* Report deployment status and the pipeline of upcoming installs to the founding team.

**Process & Systems**

* Build and maintain the deployment playbook, checklists, and tracking so the process is repeatable and scalable.
* Own the tooling that tracks deployment status, asset location, and readiness across the fleet.

### **Requirements**

* Hungry, startup mindset above all: thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, takes extreme ownership, does what it takes to make each install land.
* 3+ years in project management, implementation/deployment management, technical program management, or field-services coordination, ideally at a startup, hardware, or solutions company.
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder projects on a schedule and hold others accountable without direct authority.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a technical scope of work; talks credibly with solution engineers.
* Strong coordination and communication across internal teams, external partners, and customers.
* Highly organized and self-directed; builds process from scratch.
* Calm under pressure; biased toward closing gaps and driving at-risk deployments to resolution.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience deploying hardware or physical installations into venues or field sites.
* Familiarity with project/deployment tracking tools and a CRM (e.g., HubSpot).
* Background in logistics, shipping, or warehouse operations.
* PMP or similar credential (not required).

### **Compensation**

Not listed.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Email resume and relevant supporting materials to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Project Manager".

new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
  
  
If you're energized by the idea of bringing structure to complexity — and by the knowledge that the projects, you support are helping power a cleaner world — this role is for you.
  
  
As a Internal Project Manager & Risk Manager within GE Vernova's North America Grid Solutions Integration (NAM GSI) Behind the Meter (BTM) portfolio, play a key role in driving execution discipline and operational efficiency across complex energy infrastructure projects. You'll work closely with Senior Project Managers/Project Directors, giving them the freedom to lead customer relationships while you'll strengthen internal project execution through cross-functional coordination, proactive risk management, process standardization, and continuous improvement. You'll also champion the adoption of digital and AI-driven solutions to simplify processes, enhance project visibility, and improve execution performance.
  
  
This is an opportunity to combine your project management expertise, analytical mindset, and Lean approach to make a tangible impact on project performance, grid reliability, and the future of energy.

**Job Description**
===================

**What You'll Do:**

  
  

**Execution & Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate cross-functional activities across engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, quality, logistics, and site teams to ensure alignment with approved project execution plans.
* Track action items, deliverables, and commitments — flagging deviations early, driving resolution of execution issues and ensuring timely closure.
* Support preparation and facilitation of internal project reviews, readiness reviews, and execution meetings.
  

  

**Risk & Opportunity Management**

* Lead and coordinate the risk and opportunity management process across an assigned group of projects, facilitating structured assessment sessions with Senior Project Managers, Project Directors, Project Controllers and cross-functional teams.
* Own the accuracy, completeness, and timely updates of Risk & Opportunity Registers, ensuring traceability and alignment with company risk management standards.
* Consolidate project-level risk data to deliver a clear sub-portfolio view of exposure, trends, and potential financial and schedule impacts.
* Monitor mitigation and opportunity realization actions, ensuring clear ownership and follow-up; escalate emerging or significant risks to project/portfolio leadership.
* Prepare and maintain risk dashboards and summaries to support leadership decisions and portfolio reviews.
  

  

**Financial & Commercial Support**

* Support budget tracking, commitments, and actuals in coordination with the Project Controller.
* Assist with Estimate at Completion (EAC) reviews, internal financial reporting, and change management documentation — without owning customer negotiations.
  

  

**Process Improvement & Digital Innovation**

* Champion the adoption of AI and digital tools in project management, identifying opportunities to automate routine activities, enhance risk analysis, and improve reporting efficiency.
* Drive lessons learned, best practices, process adherence, continuous improvement, and standardization initiatives across the portfolio.
  

  

**Stakeholder Interface**

* Serve as a key internal coordination point between project teams and factories for manufacturing follow-up, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) readiness, and delivery coordination.
* Participate in customer-facing meetings only when delegated, in a supporting capacity.
  

  

**Who You Are:**

  
  

You're a detail-oriented, proactive project professional who thrives in complex environments and gets satisfaction from keeping many moving parts aligned. You bring both analytical precision and strong collaboration skills — and you know that great project outcomes are built on shared accountability and clear communication.

  
  

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field from an accredited university or college
* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, project controls, or project execution roles, preferably within power, grid, energy or EPC environment.
* Flexibility to travel up to 10% of the time based on the business needs.
* Experience supporting complex projects involving factory-manufactured equipment and cross-functional teams.
* Strong foundation in project management principles: schedule, cost, risk, and opportunity management.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a collaborative approach and attention to data integrity.
* Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional discussions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive alignment.
  

  

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience applying structured risk assessment methodologies and building risk exposure reports across multiple projects.
* Proficiency with scheduling and project tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, ERP systems, or risk management applications.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification, or progress toward it; PMI-RMP (Risk Management Professional) or equivalent is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools, digital automation, or data analytics solutions applied to project management.

**Additional Information**

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Clinglobal is an Animal Health Contract Research Organization (CRO) and member of the Clinglobal Group. We accelerate animal health innovation through a unique model that combines streamlined contracting, centralized project and program management, and a broad portfolio of preclinical, clinical, regulatory, data science, and laboratory services delivered by our group companies and strategic partners.

*Animals are our passion; people are our strength. Together, we better lives by accelerating animal health innovation.*

* Act as the primary project contact with Sponsors, maintaining communication and reporting schedules.

**Requirements**

The SPM has expert-level project management skills which allow them to lead any type of project or program, with limited supervision, and is considered the primary internal nucleus for their projects.

* Full lifecycle delivery and management of complex, technical, strategic and creative projects
* Develops and actively manages project timelines, estimates, risk registers, communication plans, burn reports and change logs with minimal oversight
* Leads the estimation process and provides project budget and staff plan parameters with minimal supervision
* Leads the project timeline creation process in close partnership with internal and external stakeholders with minimal supervision
* Leads project kickoffs and status meetings
* Creates and/or reviews and distributes meeting recaps; oversees and evolves Project Managers (PM) and Project Coordinators (PC) in their ability to write actionable recaps
* In partnership with AD and GPD, develops financial forecasts for proactive financial management
* In partnership with AD, Finance and Account, facilitates monthly billing, analysis and action
* In partnership with Account Services, AD and GPD, assists with the development of annual and project-based SOWs
* In partnership with ADs and GPD, provides input to program Gantt Charts
* In partnership with Account Services, AD and GPD, assists with change order creation and management
* Actively works with project stakeholders to identify, evaluate, log, communicate and mitigate project-level risks
* Works closely with Project Management Office (PMO) leadership to identify and mitigate program-level risks
* Identifies project staff needs and works with resource managers and PCs to ensure accuracy and updates of resource plans
* Resolves conflicts, including scope, schedule, resources, budget, quality and communication with minimal oversight
* Ensures all project artifacts (FRD, BRD, etc.) are properly stored within enterprise systems (Workfront, TFS, etc.)
* Accountable for application of Intouch delivery processes and PMO standards across their projects
* Actively mentors and supports training efforts for Project Managers and Project Coordinators
* Acts as first touchpoint of escalation for Project Managers and PCs
* Keeps direct manager informed; asks for help when needed; knows when to escalate issues/concerns to leadership; brings solutions
* Participates in candidate interviews as needed
* Effectively senses team morale and understands how to address issues
* modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

 **Qualifications**

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent education plus professional experience required
* Three to five years of experience in a PMO role
* Pharmaceutical or advertising experience preferred (AOR or DAOR)
* Advanced understanding and applications of PMO standards and processes
* Experience leading the delivery of complex, technology, strategy and creative based projects
* Ability to develop a creative, strategic or technical heavy project plan
* Ability to tailor and flex process to provide solutions to proactively facilitate a project
* Experience leading a wide range of different functional groups and project teams
* Comprehension of project forecasting and reforecasting throughout lifecycle of project
* Expert project and program burn analysis and remediation
* Excellent scope and change management tracking and adherence
* Comfortable with client-facing communication
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate, assess and mitigate risk
* Ability to build trust, negotiate and influence decision-making with Account, SMEs, Clients, Partner Agencies and third-party vendors
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Strong decision-making and implementation, especially when faced with uncertainty
* Experience working with Project Management Information Systems such as Workfront, Workfront Proof, Smartsheet, MS Project
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel
* Launch experience a plus

 **Additional Information**

**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**

**Patient Minded** I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Zone Operating Model & Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance & Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM & Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

**CRM Data Quality & Pipeline Discipline**

* Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
* Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
* Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
* Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.

**Business Requirements Management**

* Collect, consolidate, and document zone-wide and country-specific business requirements.
* Assess alignment among country needs, zone priorities, and global standards, identifying opportunities for common solutions across countries.
* Coordinate zone-level prioritization and escalation of enhancement requests with country stakeholders.
* Coordinate review and approval of zone- and country-driven process changes.

**Exception & Change Control Management**

* Manage intake, triage, and documentation of country exception requests related to CRM processes, business rules, data standards, and operating procedures.
* Assess business impact, cross-country scalability, compliance considerations, and downstream reporting implications before escalating exceptions for approval.
* Maintain traceability of approved deviations and ensure they are reviewed periodically for continued relevance or harmonization back to the global standard.

**Zone & Country Readiness and Change Management**

* Coordinate rollout of CRM capabilities, governance initiatives, and business process changes across the assigned zone.
* Work with zone and country stakeholders to coordinate training, communication, and awareness activities.
* Monitor readiness across the zone and identify country-level gaps, dependencies, and support needs for new capabilities and transformations.

new_jobs.description:
### **About Pluribus Digital:**

Join us and do work that matters: use your skills to improve how your government serves the public! Pluribus Digital partners with our government customers to design, develop, and deliver useful and impactful digital products. We are a hands-on digital services consultancy – part technologists, part change agents, and all heart. We employ modern best practices in all that we do as we work to solve problems in public health, financial industry regulation, granting citizenship and asylum, and identity and access management.

### **Role Description**

As a **Business Analyst / Functional Tester**, you will play a key role in supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS), a mission-critical federal application supporting the regulation and oversight of the health insurance marketplace. This role focuses on Operations & Maintenance (O&M), production support, user support, and incremental enhancements across numerous business modules.

Working within an Agile delivery team, you will collaborate closely with CMS stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, testers, architects, and operations personnel to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and verify, through hands-on functional testing, that what the team delivers meets those requirements. You'll own the work from requirement to validated feature, writing user stories and acceptance criteria and then testing completed work before it reaches CMS stakeholders. You will also support incident analysis, defect resolution, enhancement requests, business process improvements, and documentation efforts that enable the continued success of the system.

### **What You Will Do**

#### **Requirements & Analysis**

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements from CMS stakeholders and business users.
* Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business process documentation, workflow diagrams, and functional specifications.
* Analyze enhancement requests, production issues, and operational processes to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and user experience.
* Ensure requirements are complete, traceable, testable, and aligned with CMS objectives and governance standards.
* Maintain requirements and supporting documentation throughout the Agile delivery lifecycle.

#### **Manual & Functional Testing**

* Write and maintain test scenarios, test cases, and test data that trace directly to user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Test each story within the sprint and confirm it meets acceptance criteria before it is marked done.
* Log clear, reproducible defects with steps, expected vs. actual results, screenshots, and severity. Retest fixes and verify closure.
* Maintain a requirements traceability matrix and the test evidence that release and CMS governance reviews require.
* Do exploratory testing to find edge cases, usability problems, and gaps in requirements.
* Work with developers on defect triage and root cause, and with QA staff on test coverage and standards.

#### **Operations & Production Support**

* Support investigation and analysis of production issues, customer-reported defects, and operational questions.
* Collaborate with technical teams to reproduce issues, clarify expected system behavior, and document business impacts.
* Reproduce production issues in lower environments and confirm fixes before they are deployed.
* Assist with prioritization of defects and enhancement requests based on business value and operational needs.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities and recommend process or system improvements.
* Help maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, and user-facing documentation as system functionality evolves.

#### **Agile Delivery**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with Product Owners to refine and prioritize product backlogs.
* Ensure user stories contain sufficient business context and well-defined acceptance criteria.
* Prepare User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts, data, and environments. Guide CMS business users through UAT and track their findings to resolution.

#### **Stakeholder & Customer Engagement**

* Serve as a liaison between CMS business stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams.
* Facilitate requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.
* Communicate business needs, priorities, risks, and project status effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build collaborative relationships across multiple functional areas supporting the HIOS platform.

#### **Documentation & Process Improvement**

* Produce clear, concise documentation including business requirements, process flows, decision logs, release documentation, test plans and test results, and training materials.
* Assist with maintaining standard operating procedures and operational documentation.
* Recommend improvements to business processes, operational workflows, and support procedures based on data and stakeholder feedback.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a Moderate Risk Public Trust designation.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting enterprise software applications.
* 2+ years of hands-on manual or functional testing of web-based enterprise applications, including writing test cases and running regression tests.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and managing functional and business requirements.
* Experience logging and managing defects through their full lifecycle in Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar tool.
* Experience supporting Agile software delivery teams using Scrum or SAFe methodologies.

Today it is the central fundraising organization for the UH System and is contracted by the Board of Regents to be the sole provider of fundraising and alumni services. In addition to fundraising, the Foundation manages more than 7,000 gift accounts for the benefit of the university and its students.

The UH Foundation is a private, institutionally related corporation designated as a 501(c)(3) organization by the Internal Revenue Service. It is a legally separate entity from UH, the UH Alumni Association, and all other UH affiliates. Our Vision

To inspire giving and partnership with UH by fostering UH pride and passion among donors, alumni and the community.

Our Mission

To unite donors' passions with UH's aspirations by raising philanthropic support and managing private investments to benefit UH, the people of Hawaiʻi and our future generations.

Our Values

Our values shape our relationships and guide our thinking and actions. By living our values, we build trust with our fellow employees, our donors, the university and the broader community.

**Position Overview:**
======================

Amatriot is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst to support a Cyber Technical Analysis Unit in analyzing cyber intrusion activity, digital communications, and host/network forensic artifacts in support of DoJ mission operations.

This role is focused on cyber threat analysis, intrusion investigation, host-based forensic analysis, network traffic analysis, and attribution support within a highly sensitive operational environment.

The ideal candidate will possess experience analyzing Splunk data, conducting host and network forensic analysis, and utilizing industry-standard forensic and cyber analysis tools to identify malicious activity, recover artifacts, and support investigative operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Cyber Threat Analysis and Intrusion Investigation**

* Process, evaluate, and analyze digital network communications and cyber threat data to identify malicious activity and support investigative operations.
* Conduct cyber intrusion investigations and end-to-end kill chain analysis across host and network environments.
* Correlate digital artifacts, including IP addresses, URLs, malware indicators, system logs, and user activity across multiple data sources to support attribution and investigative lead generation.
* Support attribution and operational analysis by correlating threat indicators and investigative data.

### **Host-Based Forensic Analysis**

* Perform host-based forensic analysis leveraging Splunk and standard forensic toolsets to identify indicators of compromise, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and unauthorized access.
* Analyze encrypted and plaintext credentials, registry artifacts, rootkit activity, command-line execution, and other system-level forensic evidence.
* Recover artifacts to support investigative operations.

### **Network Traffic Analysis**

* Analyze packet capture and NetFlow data to identify malicious communications, software usage, command execution, credential activity, and network-based indicators of compromise.

### **Reporting, Process Development, and Quality Assurance**

* Draft detailed technical reports and analytical findings based on cyber investigations.
* Participate in internal review and quality assurance processes.
* Support development and refinement of cyber analysis processes, CONOPS, SOPs, and investigative methodologies.
* Provide operational updates and analytical findings to leadership and investigative stakeholders.

### **Threat Research and Mission Collaboration**

* Conduct open-source and intelligence community research to maintain awareness of emerging cyber threats, malware trends, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.

### **Experience**

* Experience performing host-based forensic analysis utilizing Splunk.
* Experience analyzing network traffic, packet capture, and NetFlow data.
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard forensic tools such as:
  + Splunk
  + EnCase
  + Magnet AXIOM
  + X-Ways Forensics
* Experience correlating threat indicators and investigative data to support attribution and operational analysis.

### **Skills**

* Understanding of cyber intrusion methodologies, attacker kill chains, malware behavior, and forensic artifact analysis.

* Active Top Secret clearance required, with willingness and ability to obtain a Counterintelligence Polygraph.

· Support HIPAA-compliant privacy frameworks, data governance, and compliance requirements.

· Maintain program documentation, reporting artifacts, and knowledge repositories.

· Provide strategic recommendations to support program growth, operational efficiency, and long-term success.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Information Technology/Information Systems, Management, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 8+ years of experience managing complex programs, including Agile program management and implementation oversight.
* Experience in stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, and governance support, including coordination across government, contractors, and healthcare organizations.
* Experience with health information technology and/or health information exchange, including EHR environments and data-sharing networks.
* Experience with health data privacy, including HIPAA.
* Experience in governance, risk management, and executive reporting, including project schedules, risk registers, and executive briefings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Experience supporting enterprise modernization, digital transformation, or data management programs.

----------------

The Maryland State Department of Education is dedicated to supporting a world-class educational system that prepares all students for college and career success in the 21st century. With excellent stewardship from our divisions, we oversee State and federal programs that support the needs of a diverse population – students, teachers, principals, and other educators throughout Maryland.

**GRADE**
---------

State Salary Grade 26

Salary Range $128,818 - $166,648 with progression to $203,150/year

* State Salary Guidelines may apply for current State employees.

**LOCATION OF POSITION**
------------------------

Nancy S. Grasmick Education Building

200 West Baltimore Street

Baltimore, MD 21201

**Main Purpose of Job**
-----------------------

The Executive Director of Literacy Programs and Initiative provides strategic and transformative leadership for the implementation of the literacy initiatives and State Literacy Framework to dramatically improve reading proficiency for students from all backgrounds in Maryland as indicated by improved outcomes on the state MCAP assessment and the NAEP exam to meet the aspirational target of Maryland to rank as one of the top ten states in reading on the 4th and 8th grade NAEP exams by 2027 established the Maryland State Board of Education. Also the position will support the State’s literacy initiatives by leading professional learning and transformative initiatives that include crafting policies aligned with Science of Reading, State and Federal requirements including but not limited to curriculum adoption, assessment, data analysis, an early warning system, interventions, and accountability.  
  

This position provides content area expertise, and oversight to all state literacy and English Language Arts (ELA) programs, projects, and initiatives Pre-K to 12 in Maryland public schools and oversees the development and deployment of best in class, research-based support to LEAs to implement comprehensive literacy programs that are aligned to the science of reading, elevate ELA content standards in teaching and learning, and ensure access to high-quality instruction for all students across the state, especially those who have been historically underserved. Additionally, the Executive Director ensures students are proficient in reading by the end of third grade and that intervention and support is available for struggling readers throughout their Pre-K to 12 learning experience, thereby ensuring students can build content knowledge across all subjects, develop critical thinking skills, and apply their skills to authentic world problems.

**POSITION DUTIES**
-------------------

In close collaboration with the Assistant State Superintendent of Instructional Programs provides Statewide Leadership for the Instructional Implementation of the Literacy Framework.  

* Leads the coherent statewide implementation of Maryland’s PreK–12 Comprehensive Literacy Policy and statewide rollout of universal literacy screening expectations (PreK–3 and Grades 4–12).
* Directs the statewide Science of Reading professional learning system, including SUNY, AIM, early childhood modules, and district‑led cohorts.
* Directs targeted technical assistance to LEAs needing support with HQIM fidelity, MTSS alignment, SRIPs, or adolescent literacy implementation.
* Oversees the development of statewide literacy guidance, standards crosswalks, instructional frameworks, SRIP templates, and intervention requirements, and statewide literacy coaching structures, including coaching networks, coaching pilots, and job‑embedded support aligned to HQIM.
* Oversees planning, allocation, and management of philanthropic, federal (Title II, CLSD), and state funds supporting literacy initiatives and monitoring of COMAR literacy reporting requirements, including annual K–3 screening, intervention data, and literacy plan implementation updates.
* Coordinates literacy policy alignment across offices including Mathematics, ML, Special Education, Accountability, Early Learning, and School Improvement.
* Ensures alignment of literacy initiatives with COMAR, statute, Blueprint requirements, MTSS guidance, statewide instructional expectations fidelity to assessment protocols and compliance with grant requirements and deliverables, stewarding funds responsibly and strategically to maximize statewide impact.
* Ensures literacy expectations are aligned with HQIM, statewide screeners, diagnostic tools, and progress‑monitoring systems.
* Develops sustainability plans for initiatives supported by time‑limited philanthropic or federal resources, budget proposals and multi‑year investment plans that prioritize system coherence, educator capacity, and equitable literacy outcomes.
* Leads the review and feedback cycles for LEA literacy plans, providing differentiated support and ensuring alignment to state policy expectations.
* Coordinates with School Library Media Specialists on access to high‑quality texts, digital resources, and knowledge‑building materials to strengthen statewide literacy ecosystems and promote statewide initiatives that enhance library media programming.
* Oversees analysis of literacy data, including K–3 screening data, Student Reading Improvement Plan (SRIP) implementation, World Class Instructional Design and Assessment (WIDA) literacy domains, Kindergarten Readiness Assessment (KRA), and Maryland Comprehensive Assessment Program / Maryland System of Testing Academic Readiness (MCAP / MSTAR) ELA.
* Uses statewide data trends to identify support needs, refine professional learning, and adjust implementation strategy.
* Serves as the primary statewide spokesperson for literacy, presenting to AIB, SBOE, legislative committees, higher ed programs, philanthropic partners, and educator audiences.
* Develops clear, consistent communication on expectations, resources, and updates tied to literacy policy implementation.
