new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Savan Group is seeking a **Senior Technical Project Manager – Application Development**  
to lead delivery of a complex federal enterprise application supporting records and information management business processes. This role is intended for an experienced technical project manager who can manage a mature Agile software development environment, lead sprint and release execution, coordinate technical and business stakeholders, and maintain disciplined delivery across development, testing, DevOps, deployment, and production support.  
  
The Senior Technical Project Manager will manage day-to-day project delivery, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog management, release planning, risks and issues, resource coordination, testing readiness, deployment coordination, production issue tracking, and client communications. The successful candidate must have strong Agile/Scrum experience and sufficient technical understanding of Java-based applications and AWS environments to effectively oversee developers and coordinate DevOps engineers, user acceptance testing, security, and other technical resources.  
  
The application supports federal records and information management functions. The Senior Technical Project Manager does not need to be a records and information management (RIM) subject matter expert but must have enough RIM, enterprise content management, document management, or information governance experience to understand the business domain and work effectively with RIM SMEs and client stakeholders. The role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical skills, disciplined follow-through, and excellent written and verbal communication.  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**

* Lead delivery of a federal enterprise Java application across requirements, development, testing, UAT, deployment, production support, and ongoing operations and maintenance.
* Own Agile/Scrum delivery activities, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Manage sprint readiness, commitments, capacity, backlog health, delivery metrics, impediments, dependencies, and completion trends.
* Work with product owners, client stakeholders, technical leads, and business analysts to prioritize the backlog and ensure user stories and acceptance criteria are ready for development.
* Develop and maintain project plans, sprint and release schedules, resource assignments, risks and issues, decisions, action items, and dependency tracking.
* Lead and coordinate a multidisciplinary delivery team that may include Java developers, architects, testers, DevOps engineers, business analysts, RIM specialists, and other technical resources.
* Coordinate development, system and regression testing, UAT, defect resolution, deployment, and production-readiness activities.
* Coordinate release readiness across development, testing, UAT, security, accessibility, DevOps, and production support, ensuring unresolved dependencies and risks are identified and addressed before deployment.
* Support coordination of AWS environments, CI/CD activities, deployments, infrastructure dependencies, application monitoring, and production issue resolution.
* Track and drive resolution of risks, issues, defects, production incidents, technical dependencies, and cross-team impediments.
* Analyze project, application, testing, defect, operational, and delivery data to identify trends, assess risks, investigate issues, and support data-driven recommendations.
* Translate business, technical, RIM, security, accessibility, and operational requirements into actionable development work and implementation plans.
* Review project, sprint, release, and client-facing documentation for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and quality.
* Prepare clear project status reports, sprint and release reporting, executive briefings, recommendations, meeting materials, and other client communications.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) from an accredited college or university.
* U.S. Citizenship and the ability to acquire and maintain a Public Trust or other client-required suitability determination are required.
* 8+ years of professional experience in information technology, software development delivery, project or program management, management consulting, or a closely related field.
* At least 5 years of experience managing software development projects or major technical workstreams, including responsibility for planning, schedules, deliverables, risks and issues, client communications, resource coordination, and team performance.
* At least 3 years of direct experience managing Scrum-based software development delivery, including sprint planning, standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Demonstrated experience applying Agile and Scrum methodologies in a production software development environment.
* Strong experience using Jira or a comparable Agile project management platform to manage backlogs, user stories, sprints, defects, releases, dependencies, and delivery metrics.
* Experience managing the development and delivery of Java-based enterprise applications, with sufficient technical understanding to effectively coordinate developers, architects, testers, DevOps engineers, and other technical personnel.
* Experience supporting or managing enterprise applications hosted in AWS, including familiarity with cloud environments, infrastructure dependencies, deployments, monitoring, and production operations.
* Experience managing a mature enterprise application environment that includes enhancement development, defect resolution, testing, release management, production support, and ongoing operations and maintenance.
* Familiarity with enterprise application architecture, APIs and integrations, relational and NoSQL databases, enterprise search technologies, AWS infrastructure, messaging services, and C

new_jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
SiloSmashers, Inc. is a leading management and IT consulting firm, serving as a trusted advisor and solutions partner to a diverse range of government, business, and not-for-profit organizations. Applying proven expertise and methodologies, we help our customers align and mobilize every aspect of their operations, strengths, and resources to achieve Peak Performance and increased business value today and through the years ahead.

**Position Overview**

SiloSmashers is hiring a Junior Data Analyst to provide analytical, research, and data management support for a government customer. This position supports mission-critical operations by collecting, organizing, reviewing, and analyzing data to identify trends, develop reports, and provide actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making. The Junior Data Analyst will work collaboratively with government personnel and internal stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, respond to data inquiries, maintain accurate records, and support ad hoc analytical projects. Responsibilities include preparing reports, briefings, and presentations; maintaining databases and spreadsheets; and reviewing complex legal and non-legal documents to support research and analytical activities. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical and research skills, attention to detail, proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and relevant data management tools, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced federal environment. Success in this role requires professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, and adherence to established procedures and security protocols.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in ad hoc data projects and analyses that produce actionable recommendations that build relevant insights for internal and external stakeholders.
* Collect data and run basic reports in response to client inquiries.
* Work closely with key internal stakeholders to ensure sound knowledge of client requirements to support development of best-in-class analytical solutions.
* Accurately enter required data into one or more databases, documents and/or spreadsheets.

**Preferred Skills**

* Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and reporting.
* Experience supporting data collection, quality assurance, and database maintenance.
* Strong written communication skills, including preparation of reports, briefings, and presentations.
* Ability to research, review, and interpret complex legal and non-legal documents.
* Experience working in a federal government, law enforcement, or other regulated environment.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Must maintain an active Top Secret clearance.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with two (2) or more years of general office assistant experience.
* Three (3) years or more of Data Analytical experience on data management activities as well as Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, Microsoft Access, and Adobe Acrobat.
* Competence to review, interpret, and evaluate complex legal and non-legal documents.
* This position requires physical attendance at the customer site.

new_jobs.title: Warehouse Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
*Turn warehouse data into the decisions that keep high-tech supply chains moving.* ***This position is based in Virginia and is NOT REMOTE***

The Dulles corridor runs on data. From the data centers of Loudoun County to the air cargo moving through Dulles Airport, this region is where logistics and technology meet, and this role sits right at that intersection.

At Arnoff, our partner Dulles facility supports a forward stocking location for a leading technology customer, where the right part in the right place at the right time really matters. We are looking for a Warehouse Data Analyst who loves clean numbers, sharp reports, and finding the story hiding in a spreadsheet. You will be the person that we rely on to know exactly what is on hand, what shipped, and how we are performing.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE

* **Real impact, fast. Your reports go straight to program managers, supervisors, and Finance, and they drive daily decisions, customer scorecards, and billing.**
* **Room to build.** We want recurring reports to be automated. If you like that automation, you will have a real playground to put it to work.
* **Be the go-to person.** You will serve as Arnoff's representative and main point of contact at the facility, and you will train teammates on our reports and systems.
* **Learn the whole operation.** You will get hands-on with the warehouse floor so your analysis is grounded in how the work actually happens, which is great experience for a career in supply chain analytics or program management. **Inventory experience preferred in a manufacturing setting.**
* **A schedule that fits life.** Weekday daytime hours with overtime eligibility, in a location that is easy to reach from Loudoun, western Fairfax, and the Route 28 corridor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the reporting rhythm

* Run and distribute assigned reports, including on-hand inventory and requested transactional reports.
* Run the shipment and location reports that set the Supervisor up for the day.
* Compile and enter milestone data for the daily milk run.
* Prepare weekly and monthly cycle count reports for the Program Manager.

Power the numbers that matter

* Build the data behind scorecard updates and KPI, SLA, volume, and spend reporting.
* Provide billing data to the Program Manager and Finance every billing cycle.
* Supply controllable-error data to support warehouse performance reviews.
* Spot data discrepancies and flag them to the Supervisor for correction.

Make it better

* Automate recurring reports and keep report documentation current.
* Train staff on reports and system use.
* Serve as Arnoff's main point of contact at the facility and support project management as needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

* A bachelor's degree in analytics, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years in reporting or analytics, ideally in warehousing or logistics.
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, lookups). Power BI or Tableau is a big plus.
* Experience pulling and reconciling data from existing systems.
* A working understanding of inventory concepts like shrinkage, cycle counts, and on-hand buckets.
* Clear, accurate writing that turns findings into actionable insights.

Bonus points if you have military logistics, supply, or 3PL experience, or if you can't leave a broken formula alone.

**Location**

**On-site in Dulles, VA, close to Route 28, the Dulles Toll Road, and Washington Dulles International Airport ( no relocation opportunities available)**

Schedule

Weekdays, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (40 hours, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch). No nights, no weekends.

Pay type

Hourly, overtime-eligible (non-exempt)

**Pay range**

**$32 - $36 per Hour**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Dulles, Virginia

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
This individual may work remotely up to two (2) days per week, equivalent to approximately 40% remote and 60% onsite.  
  

Scope of Work
  
The client is seeking a qualified Senior Business Analyst to assess, develop, enhance, and implement technology solutions in support of client agencies. The position will primarily focus on the analysis, improvement, and implementation of Public Safety systems and business processes.
  
The initial assignment will support the replacement of the client’s Jail Management System. Business requirements have already been captured, and the Senior Business Analyst will work closely with client stakeholders, subject matter experts, technology teams, and vendors to validate and refine requirements, evaluate solutions, support vendor activities, and assist with the successful implementation of the new system.
  
The ideal candidate will have strong business analysis skills, experience with complex technology implementations, and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Experience with public safety systems or related government applications is highly desirable.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities
  
Develops functional/non-functional system requirements using documented business requirements.
  
Works with development staff and/or vendors to create prototype designs for medium to large-risk projects.
  
Creates detailed unit/system testing scripts based on functional requirements.
  
Facilitate user acceptance testing processes as required.
  
Assesses and develops recommendations for process improvements and technology solutions for client agencies.
  
Captures, consolidates, and communicates information from the Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
  
Responsible for the high-level design and integration of software development by effectively partnering with business users, project managers and application developers.

Actively pursue innovative initiatives and improvements in current processes.
  
Gather/document business requirements for change requests (break/fix).
  
Support internal/external integrations, including design, testing and troubleshooting.

Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science or a related field and five years’ experience in systems analysis, change management analysis, project management, program analysis, or a closely related field.

Knowledge of the principles and practices of planning, developing, implementing, and maintaining computer information systems.

Skilled in analyzing and evaluating administrative processes for automation.
  
Ability to assist in the analysis and evaluation of the feasibility and suitability of information technology projects. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships. Ability to create precise and effective technical documentation.
  
Excellent oral and written communication skills with internal and external clients and vendors.
  
Ability to produce documentation that will be used by various audiences, including but not limited to design documents for each application being reviewed that will include business requirements, functional specifications, test plans and scripts.
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
Outstanding business process fluency, with a strong ability to discuss processes at a level of detail sufficient to gain insight into the underlying business problem or opportunity.
  
Ability to work in a team environment; establishing and maintaining strong professional relationships.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Index Analytics, LLC, is a rapidly growing, Baltimore-based small business providing health-related consulting services to the federal government. At the center of our company culture is a commitment to instilling a dynamic and employee-friendly place to work. We place a priority on promoting a supportive and collegial team environment and enhancing staff experience through career development and educational opportunities.

**Position Overview**

The incumbent will leverage domain expertise, advanced analytics, and research methodologies to transform complex healthcare data into actionable insights. The Senior Researcher/Analyst plays a key role in shaping high‑impact solutions related to the program using statistical analysis, data mining, programming, and qualitative research to inform policy, optimize operations, and improve health outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct research on best practices and analyze diverse Medicaid and Children’s Health Insurance Program (CHIP) data sources including claims, TAF, program oversight metrics, scorecards, and performance data to identify patterns, clusters, and insights that inform policy, operational improvements, and feature development for CMS business needs.
* Perform routine and exploratory data analysis using statistical methods, predictive modeling, and state-of-the-art data mining techniques to build predictive models, uncover trends, and generate actionable insights.
* Develop and deliver high-quality reports, ad hoc analyses, and data visualizations grounded in HCD and UX best practices to help clients interpret complex information and support decision-making.
* Work collaboratively in an agile environment with data analysts, data scientists, and internal/external clients to define analytical requirements, develop value-added solutions, and enhance business operations.
* Lead development of analytic products using Medicaid and CHIP data to meet a variety of use cases from pilot studies to operational and reporting dashboards that will require extensive research, data discovery, analysis, and validation.
* Manage development and release of assigned research projects and analytic use cases independently or working together with a team providing guidance and direction to technical and non-technical staff.
* Prepare technical deliverables including presentation decks, reports, and draft manuscripts communicating findings to clients and scientific audiences through clear, compelling presentations that translate complex concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Integrate qualitative design research with exploratory data analysis to provide insights that support improved health policy and better outcomes for Medicaid and CHIP populations.
* Use analytics and data expertise to provide input to and review of documentation, reference, and training materials related to analytic approaches, data structures and content, and data quality observations.

**Qualifications**

* U.S. citizen or otherwise authorized to work in the United States and able to demonstrate physical residency in the U.S. for at least 3 of the past 5 years.
* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 10 years of experience (or equivalent combination of education and experience) with at least 4 years of experience designing and conducting research studies, implementing analytic use cases, and building ad hoc or planned work products. Four years of specialized experience may substitute for a bachelor’s degree.
* Experience applying statistical methods including distributions, hypothesis testing, regression and conducting complex data analyses with visualization techniques to support data-driven decision-making for program administration, policymaking, and oversight.
* Direct experience performing data analytics using SQL or PySpark is required.
* Hands-on experience with TAF data, CMS-416T reports, and processes for generating state health outcome metrics is required. Experience with DQ Atlas or Scorecard is a plus.
* Subject matter expertise in text analytics is preferred and experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques using Python or similar technologies is a plus.
* Proficiency in Python and R is a plus.
* Prior experience with Center for Medicare Medicaid Services (CMS) or other Gov’t agencies is a plus.
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.

**JOB SUMMARY**

This position is located in the Central Detention Facility (CDF) or the Correctional Treatment Facility (CTF), located at 1901 D Street, SE Washington, DC. This position is located in the D.C. Department of Corrections (DOC), Deputy Director for Administration, Cluster Accreditation and Compliance Unit.

The DOC is mandated by the District of Columbia Council to achieve and maintain accreditation by the American Correctional Association (ACA), a national governing body. This position is responsible for carrying out parts of the accreditation process and has a critical impact on the operation of the facility.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Supports the Audit Compliance Manager in creating program management assessment guidelines/policies, conducts periodic audits/evaluations as well as follow-up on adherence monitoring with the Agency to determine staff performance, compliance with applicable policy procedures, and standards, and administration of external contract services. Serves as agency liaison for the ACA applicants, pre-audit, correspondent, candidates, audits, and accreditation hearing process. Plans and organizes, conducts, and documents scheduled inspections to ensure that operations and programs are accomplished and in compliance as outlined in the policy and procedures; and represents the institution or program before the Commission on Accreditation at panel hearing for re-accreditation; assists with developing management operations assessment criteria for the Compliance and Accreditation Office.

Coordinates aspects of the program audit/evaluation, including interviews, gathering facts, and other date reviewing a wide variety of records and reports, analyzing data and determining the sufficiency, reliability and relevance of evidence used to support the conclusions and recommendation for approval implementation. Provides advisory services on identified problem area with agency program managers, prepares written reports that address findings and recommendations and develops and maintains an effective follow up system to assure responsive and timely replies to audit/evaluation reports and the appropriate corrective actions are taken in a timely manner.

None.

**Ft. Belvoir, VA**

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Job ID: 2618264

**Location:** Washington, DC, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-22

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Project Analyst

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 25% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** None

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** Secret

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

As an **Associate Program Analyst**, the candidate will support Test and Evaluation (T&E) of Foreign Military Sales (FMS) AEGIS surface ships and weapons systems for Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Mission Systems [formerly PEO IWS] at the Navy Yard in Washington, DC. Oversees and manages the operational aspects of ongoing projects and serves as liaison between project management and planning, project team, and line management. Reviews status of projects and budgets; manages schedules and prepares status reports. Assesses project issues and develops resolutions to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals and objectives. Develops mechanisms for monitoring project progress and for intervention and problem solving with project managers, line managers, and clients.

Your work will contribute to the successful at-sea testing of new construction and modernized AEGIS combat systems and ships for various US Navy International Partners. Your work will include understanding system capabilities; identifying requirements for at-sea testing; translating capabilities and test requirements to Test Objectives; using the Planning, Execution, Analysis, and Reporting (PEAR) process to develop test scenarios to evaluate Test Objectives; defining and validating resources needed to meet test scenario requirements; advising the test execution team during scenario execution; and ensuring data collection and analysis plans support reporting requirements. You will provide program office administrative and engineering support in the development of FMS cases. This project will include working on a team with senior engineers and program office personnel.

Support roles will include planning and delivering multi agency meetings to include presentation material, overall coordination, and tracking and closing action associated from the meetings. You will be required to maintain Confluence and Jira Project planning material. Assistance will be given to the program office representative to create and promulgate budgeting material. Prior US Navy or military experience is preferable ,but not required as self starters can be very effective in the job, so a lack of USN or military background should not discourage from applying.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline (Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field); In lieu of a technical degree, a minimum of 4 years of relevant U.S. Navy technical experience is required and acceptable.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information into clear test documentation and requirements.
* The position requires occasional travel to FMS countries such as Japan, South Korea, Australia or Spain to visit US test ranges or warfare centers.
* Ability to obtain an Interim Secret clearance or currently hold an active Secret clearance.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Relevant experience includes Navy ratings such as Fire Controlman (FC), Electronics Technician (ET), AEGIS Display Technician (ADTT), Operations Specialist (with AEGIS console experience), or other roles directly supporting AEGIS Combat Systems or shipboard combat system operations.
* Prior US Navy or military experience is preferable ,but not required as self starters can be very effective in the job, so a lack of USN or military background should not discourage from applying.
* Previous hands-on experience with the AEGIS Weapon System, either aboard ship or in a test, training, or integration environment.
* Technical background in combat systems, fire control, radar systems, electronic warfare, or naval systems integration.
* Familiarity with Test & Evaluation processes such as test planning, scenario development, data analysis, or operational testing.
* Experience using JIRA and Confluence for project or test management.
* Understanding of DoD acquisition processes or prior experience supporting NAVSEA, PEO IWS, or PAE Mission Systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, test officers, and program office personnel.

Target salary range: $40,001 - $80,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

new_jobs.title: Train Overhaul Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**TAKE YOUR CAREER IN A NEW DIRECTION**

At Eurostar, we’re fuelling the future of rail travel – operating in five countries and sparking new opportunities for travellers. But our trains connect much more than just people and places. They’re helping us build a greener, more inclusive future for everyone. Join us and you’ll be part of a passionate team which always goes the extra mile.
  
  
An exciting opportunity awaits you as **Train Overhaul Project Manager** in our Rolling Stock department. The Train Overhaul Project Manager (internally known as R Exam Project Manager) will manage all aspects of the R exam overhaul and e320 major programmes for Eurostar. This requires management and coordination of all internal and external work streams and the residual work required to complete R exams including any depot modifications required within the agreed project timescales. The role will also lead and support other Engineering projects as required.

This is a **permanent** role is based on site at our **Temple Mills depot in Leyton**. Hybrid working is available, with the expectation you attend site 4 days per week.

**The close date for this role is 9AM on Monday, 9 November 2026**. Candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible; Eurostar reserves the right to contact candidates before close date and to close the role earlier if suitable candidates are identified.

*Internal use only: Grade F travel services 4-5.*

 **Requirements**

**We’re looking for someone to:**

* Lead the delivery of the R Exam overhaul programme, ensuring milestones are achieved safely, on time, and to the required quality standards.
* Manage and coordinate multiple internal and external project workstreams, aligning activities across Engineering, Fleet Planning, Production, Quality, Procurement, and supplier organisations.
* Monitor fleet maintenance schedules and running kilometre targets, ensuring R Exams are planned and delivered within vehicle maintenance requirements.
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks, implementing mitigation plans and escalating issues appropriately to senior stakeholders.
* Chair project governance and review meetings, providing clear progress updates and driving actions to resolve delays, quality concerns, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Siemens and other suppliers to oversee contractual deliverables, material readiness, quality performance, and supplier compliance throughout the programme lifecycle.
* Support the development of future maintenance and overhaul strategies, including optimisation initiatives to improve fleet availability, reliability, and operational performance.
* Develop business cases, manage project budgets and reporting activities, and maintain effective stakeholder engagement across the UK and mainland Europe.

**You'll need...**

* Proven project management experience delivering complex engineering or rolling stock projects from planning through to implementation.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build effective relationships across multiple organisations.
* Experience managing project risks, dependencies, and change activities within a safety-critical or regulated environment.
* Good understanding of engineering governance, legislation, industry standards, and safety management principles.
* Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, contractors, and technical specialists to deliver project objectives.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills, with experience using project management tools and software to track progress and performance.
* Knowledge of rolling stock maintenance, train operations, fleet management, or rail engineering environments would be advantageous.
* Educated to HNC, HND, Degree level, or equivalent in Engineering, Project Management, or a related discipline; IOSH and/or risk management qualifications would be desirable.

  
**Benefits**

We’re constantly working to create a bright future for our company and our colleagues. That’s why we offer a wide range of brilliant benefits, including:

* Travel benefits that can be used for both work and play including 75% off underground network from Day 1
* Competitive defined benefit pension scheme
* Free Eurostar tickets
* Discounted Eurostar tickets for friends and family
* Ongoing training and development
* Free, confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme
* Peer-to-Peer support from trained Mental Health First Aiders/Personne de Confiance
* Lots of other exclusive deals, discounts and perks

A whole new platform for your career - If you think you’ve got what it takes to help us make Eurostar bigger and better than ever before then we’d love to hear from you.

**Hello. We’re Teya.**

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

**Teya exists to change that.**

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

**Senior Data Analyst – Enterprise Risk**
=========================================

**The role**
------------

Teya is building its Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and strengthening how risk information is brought together, analysed and reported across the business.

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in turning risk data into reliable measures, meaningful insights and actionable reporting. You'll work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and stakeholders across Credit, Fraud, AML, People, IT, Operations and Finance to understand the risks facing the business, identify the right data to monitor them, and develop effective reporting and early-warning capabilities.

This is a business-facing analytical role. Understanding risk, working effectively with risk owners and translating their requirements into practical data solutions will be just as important as your technical skills. You'll help ensure key risk indicators (KRIs) are meaningful, data is reliable, thresholds are appropriately informed by analysis, and reporting supports better risk oversight and decision-making.

You'll also help modernise how risk reporting is produced, using AI models and workflow automation to bring together internal data and relevant external information, identify emerging issues and reduce manual effort. The focus is on practical application, with robust validation, traceability and human oversight.

This is an opportunity to combine risk expertise, analytical problem-solving and emerging AI capabilities to help shape how a growing fintech business identifies, monitors and manages risk.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Develop risk data and reporting:** Identify and map relevant data sources, using tools such as Snowflake to build repeatable datasets for KRIs across operational, credit, fraud, AML, people, capital, liquidity and other risk categories.
* **Partner with risk stakeholders:** Work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and risk owners across the business to understand their priorities, clarify reporting requirements and translate risk management needs into practical analytical solutions.
* **Analyse and monitor risk indicators:** Use SQL and Python to investigate trends, test assumptions, identify anomalies and understand changes in risk exposure. Help risk owners interpret findings and determine where further investigation or action may be needed.
* **Support KRI definitions and thresholds:** Work with risk stakeholders to validate indicator definitions, assess data quality and analyse historical and current performance to inform threshold calibration. Help ensure indicators provide meaningful insight into the risks they are intended to monitor.
* **Build dashboards and management reporting:** Develop clear, accessible dashboards using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools, supporting monthly ERMF reporting and management oversight.
* **Automate risk reporting with AI:** Build and improve AI-enabled workflows that bring together internal data and relevant external signals, including regulatory updates, market developments, news and emerging threats. Help generate evidence-based reporting drafts for review by the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and CRO.
* **Develop early-warning capabilities:** Help design and test approaches to monitor KRI movements and operational data throughout the month, highlighting unusual patterns and potential emerging risks with clear supporting evidence for investigation.
* **Support risk technology and integration:** Translate ERMF and reporting requirements into practical data, integration and workflow specifications for Teya's governance, risk and compliance (GRC) solution, partnering with Risk, Data and Technology colleagues on implementation.
* **Improve data quality and governance:** Document data sources, definitions, lineage, refresh frequencies, validation checks and limitations to ensure reporting is consistent, explainable and reliable.
* **Drive continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, improve analytical processes and strengthen how risk information is used across the business.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to support the design and implementation of the future operating model for the Office of the CIO, with a particular focus on technology risk management, governance, controls and SMF24 compliance.

This is a hands-on transformation role requiring someone who can work across Technology, Risk and senior stakeholders to translate regulatory and risk-management requirements into a practical and sustainable operating model.

The role will help define how the Office of the CIO operates in BAU, including its governance structure, accountabilities, decision rights, risk and control processes, management information, committee framework and escalation routes.

The successful candidate will combine strong business analysis and target operating model experience with practical knowledge of technology/operational risk, governance and the Senior Managers & Certification Regime (SM&CR).

**About the Job**

**What you’ll spend your time doing**

Operating Model & Governance

* Support the design of the target operating model for the Office of the CIO.
* Assess current governance, risk, control and reporting arrangements and identify gaps against the required future state.
* Define future-state capabilities, processes, roles, responsibilities, decision rights and operating procedures.
* Establish clear interfaces between Technology, the Office of the CIO, Risk, Compliance and other governance functions.
* Develop governance structures, committee arrangements and Terms of Reference, including membership, decision rights, escalation routes and reporting requirements.
* Support implementation and transition of the new operating model into BAU.

Risk Management & Controls

* Support the development of the CIO/Technology Risk Management Framework and associated standards.
* Define risk ownership, control ownership, risk processes and governance requirements.
* Develop clear accountability across Lines 1, 1.5 and 2, including RACIs and escalation routes.
* Review existing risk and control processes, identifying gaps, duplication and unclear accountability.
* Support the definition of risk identification, assessment, acceptance, monitoring and reporting processes.
* Ensure risk and control information is effectively incorporated into CIO governance and management reporting.

SMF24 & Regulatory Governance

* Translate SMF24 responsibilities and accountabilities into effective governance, processes, controls and management information.
* Map SMF24 accountabilities to governance forums, controls, decision rights and escalation routes.
* Develop responsibility and accountability mapping that demonstrates clear ownership and oversight.
* Support the establishment and mobilisation of governance forums required to support SMF24 responsibilities.
* Ensure the operating model supports appropriate governance evidence and demonstrable management oversight.

Business Analysis

* Facilitate workshops with Technology, Risk and senior stakeholders.
* Elicit, analyse and document business, governance and regulatory requirements.
* Produce current and future-state process maps, RACIs, capability models and operating model documentation.
* Perform gap and impact assessments.
* Translate complex risk, regulatory and technology concepts into clear, concise documentation.
* Develop options and recommendations to support senior management decisions.

**What you’ll need**

We are looking for someone who can operate at the intersection of technology, risk, regulation and operating-model design.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

We are seeking a Wallet & Card Program Manager to lead the strategy, design, and technical implementation of our digital wallet, deposit account and debit card programs in the United States. This role sits at the intersection of product, payments technology, and U.S. banking regulation, and will own the end-to-end lifecycle of wallet and card solutions — from product vision through sponsor bank, processor and network integration, to launch and optimization.

* Strategic thinking with strong execution mindset
* Strong technical fluency

This role owns each deployment end to end and works daily with sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics.

### **Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Deployment Ownership**

* Single accountable owner for each deployment, from signed contract to a live, working installation at the customer site.
* Run the deployment schedule: define milestones, sequence dependencies, track status, surface risks and blockers early.
* Internal hub across sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics so nothing falls between teams.

**Scope & Solution Engineering**

* Drive a clear, complete SOW from sales and sales engineering before each deployment starts; push back when scope is ambiguous.
* Track solution engineers through implementation against the SOW, keeping configuration and readiness on schedule.
* Translate customer requirements and site constraints into a concrete deployment plan.

**Logistics & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate with the office/logistics owner and the third-party delivery partner on delivery windows, pickup, and destination readiness.
* Confirm warehouse readiness before each deployment: items staged, configured, health-checked before shipping.
* Manage installation scheduling and any returns or de-installations.

**Customer & Communication**

* Customer-facing point of contact during rollout: set expectations, communicate timelines, manage change requests.
* Run deployment kickoffs and post-deployment reviews; capture lessons; feed improvements into the playbook.
* Report deployment status and the pipeline of upcoming installs to the founding team.

**Process & Systems**

* Build and maintain the deployment playbook, checklists, and tracking so the process is repeatable and scalable.
* Own the tooling that tracks deployment status, asset location, and readiness across the fleet.

### **Requirements**

* Hungry, startup mindset above all: thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, takes extreme ownership, does what it takes to make each install land.
* 3+ years in project management, implementation/deployment management, technical program management, or field-services coordination, ideally at a startup, hardware, or solutions company.
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder projects on a schedule and hold others accountable without direct authority.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a technical scope of work; talks credibly with solution engineers.
* Strong coordination and communication across internal teams, external partners, and customers.
* Highly organized and self-directed; builds process from scratch.
* Calm under pressure; biased toward closing gaps and driving at-risk deployments to resolution.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience deploying hardware or physical installations into venues or field sites.
* Familiarity with project/deployment tracking tools and a CRM (e.g., HubSpot).
* Background in logistics, shipping, or warehouse operations.
* PMP or similar credential (not required).

### **Compensation**

Not listed.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Email resume and relevant supporting materials to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Project Manager".

**About the Project Management Office Team:** Our team provides centralized IT project management for technology-related projects across all County departments. We use standard project management principles, processes, tools, and software to ensure consistent project delivery approach and success.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

**We currently have one (1) full-time vacancy for a Senior IT Project Manager (County Classification: Senior Systems Engineer) in the Project Management Office (PMO) of the Information Services and Technology (IST) department.** The primary function of this assignment is senior-level IT project management, not hands-on systems engineering.

This is an opportunity for a Senior IT Project Manager to manage and deliver significant IT projects and contribute to how technology projects are delivered across Marin County, while supporting innovation, collaboration, and improved public outcomes.

Reporting to the IT Manager of PMO, the Senior IT Project Manager works with a team of IT professionals to manage health and delivery of IT projects across all methodologies (agile, hybrid, waterfall) with varied technology applications. They are responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle, stakeholders, project documentation, serve as technical specialists, operate independently with minimal supervision and provide mentorship to junior team members when needed. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO Program through developing, updating and documenting project management policies, standards and guidelines to align with organizational goals.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

The ideal candidate has senior project management experience and has previously served in a project management office. This individual has managed the implementation of IT projects independently, throughout the project lifecycle, across all project methodologies, with a proven track record of successful implementations. They possess strong knowledge of project management and technical understanding to effectively lead technology projects, collaborate with technical teams, evaluate risks and dependencies, and communicate technical considerations to business stakeholders. They should have experience of mentoring team members, manage customer interactions and engage with diverse groups of stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills are expected for cross functional collaboration with stakeholders across the organization and external parties.

Specifically, they are experienced in the following:

* All aspects of technology project management lifecycle across project methodologies (waterfall, hybrid and agile) while adhering to departmental policies and standards.
* Proficient and have a proven track record in delivering projects on time and on budget.
* Mentoring project management professionals in a team environment.
* Building collaborative partnerships across business and technical teams.
* Experience of technology (including system design, integration, testing, deployment, lifecycle management, compliance and vendor management).
* Analyzing client needs and managing project plan and stakeholder alignment.
* Adaptable with strong problem-solving mindset to maintain project critical path, with escalations as appropriate.
* Engagement and negotiation with external vendors/consultants to meet business requirements (including contract construction and budget tracking).
* Providing reports and conducting presentations for project stakeholders.
* Using data, metrics, and dashboards to support project decision-making.
* Promoting innovation and modern service delivery practice to support collaboration and productivity in project management practices.
* Staying current and updated with Project Management Institute (PMI) best practices and making recommendations regarding advancements and changes.

  
Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or related credentials

**Job Type:** Full-Time l **Location:** San Francisco, CA l **Department:** AI Infrastructure Supply Chain l **Reporting to:** Director, Supply Chain Analytics | **Work Location Type:** #hybrid
  
  
IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.
  
  
The **Program Manager, Supply Chain Analytics** enables the modernization of IREN’s global supply chain systems and tools portfolio by turning data into decisions: forecasts, supplier risk signals, should-cost models, Clear to Build dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows that enable the Supply Chain team to scale. Reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering, this individual will shape the analysis, modeling and AI layer on top: framing the business question, building envisioning solutions, and applying LLM and agentic tools to supply chain work.
  
  
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

* Support cross-functional implementations of analytics, dashboards, and AI-based tools by program managing requirements across stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in statistics, data science, engineering, economics, supply chain or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Staff Revenue Operations Analyst**

**Overview**

onsemi is seeking a highly analytical, commercially sharp, and action-oriented **Revenue Operations Analyst** to drive forecast accuracy, revenue execution, and supply alignment. This role requires strong ownership, advanced analytics capability, and the ability to convert market signals, customer demand, and complex data into decisive business actions.

We need a proactive problem solver who communicates with confidence, challenges assumptions, and reacts quickly to changing market conditions across customers, regions, and channels.

  

Responsibilities

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the weekly revenue roll across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and business stakeholders, consolidating inputs, reconciling gaps, and driving alignment on the latest outlook.
* Manage POS targets and performance, identify gaps and upside opportunities, and coordinate corrective actions with commercial stakeholders.
* Own the recurring revenue meeting, including agenda development, executive-ready slide deck preparation, decision framing, and follow-up on actions and owners.
* Pressure-test customer forecast changes with Sales and respond quickly to market shifts.
* Identify demand risks and upside opportunities early, then drive practical mitigation plans.
* Maintain a clear view of supply availability and capacity constraints, quantify and summarize demand-to-supply gaps, and drive mitigation actions to reduce risk or capture upside opportunities.
* Analyze price changes to quantify ASP, margin, and revenue impact and identify key risks and opportunities.
* Organize quarterly business review analysis and lead the meeting with key insights, decision points, and actionable recommendations.
* Support AOP and 5-Year Strategic Plan cycles with rigorous, data-backed demand projections.
* Analyze historical trends, booking patterns, channel inventory, customer signals, and market movement to sharpen forecast accuracy.
* Translate analytics into margin-aware decisions that strengthen revenue quality and business performance.
* Conduct price analysis to assess ASP movement, customer pricing behavior, margin impact, and revenue risk or upside opportunities.
* Monitor and control distribution channel inventory, including weeks of inventory and aging exposure.
* Drive channel inventory management by tracking stock levels, aging exposure, sell-through trends, and inventory quality across distribution partners.
* Communicate recommendations crisply across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, and BU leadership.
* Push cross-functional alignment and hold teams accountable to demand planning actions.
* Build a compelling revenue narrative by translating complex data, business drivers, risks, and opportunities into clear executive-level storytelling.
* Develop scenario plans and sensitivity analyses to quantify revenue outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and support timely decisions.

Present executive-ready insights and decisions with clarity, urgency, and business impact.

  

* Qualifications

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Analytics, Engineering, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, forecasting, revenue operations, or business analytics.
* Advanced analytical skills with strong proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data modeling, and forecast performance analysis.
* Experience with ERP, planning, or demand management systems, including Blue Yonder or similar tools.
* Strong working knowledge of forecasting systems, demand planning processes, channel inventory management, and price analysis.
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence, challenge assumptions, and align cross-functional teams.
* Experience in the semiconductor industry and channel business models.

  

About Us

  

**onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future.
